Ngua yakwa ni ya langi wa nthambalau.

Ni langi niwendete muno!

title: 0189_utathi.md
text: Niwise langi syonthe sya utathi?

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text: Nau endete ũsũũ.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text:
Nyie nendete
konivulekisi.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text: Nau endete Kaawa.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text: Nyie nendete ĩia.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text:
Nau endete matunda
ma mũthemba wa avoo.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text:
Nyie nendete
masungwa.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text:
Nau endete mukate.
ĩndi nyie nendete
mũkate wa tositi.

title: 0215_liu-wa-kwakya.md
text:
Ĩthyĩ twĩ eli nĩtwendete
itumbũa.

title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
text:
Tene tene vyu vaĩ na
mũndũũme wekalaa na mũka
na kũmwenda mũno.
Mũthenya ũmwe nĩwaendie
kĩthekanĩ. Enzĩanĩ nĩwakomanie
na mwĩĩtu mũasa, mũtheke na
mwanake.
Nĩwamwendie kwa mĩtukĩ.
Mwĩĩtu nake nĩwamwĩtĩkĩlile
omĩtũkĩ ĩndĩ amũtavya kana
enondo ĩmwe tu.

title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
text:
Nĩwamũie athi mũsyĩ akatile
mũka nondo ĩmwe amwetee
avikye nondo ilĩ nikana matonye
kũtwaana.
Mũndũũme ũsu nĩwasembie
mũsyĩ, osa kavyũ, avalũkya
mũka nthĩ, na omĩtũkĩ amũtila
nondo.

title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
text:
Nĩwasembie asyoka kĩthekanĩ
vala watiĩte mwendwa wake.
Ĩndĩ ndamwĩthĩa. Nĩwamwĩtie
kwa ĩsyitwa na wasya mũnene,
ĩndĩ nĩkwethĩiwe kĩvindyo
kĩnene.
Na ĩndĩ niwew’ie wasya
ũkyasya, “wĩtana nĩkĩ? Nũndũ
ũtesĩ wĩkĩthekanĩ kya
Mũsambwa wa Limbeeletwela?”

title: 0244_mwiitu-ula-waina-nondo-imwe.md
text:
Ĩla mũndũũme ũsu wew’ie ũu,
nĩwasembie mũsyĩ mĩtũkĩ ta
kĩsasi...
Ĩndĩ nĩwethĩie mũka akw’a.
Nĩwakwatiwe ni kyeva kingĩ na
nũndũ wa ũndũ ũla wekĩte nake
akw’a.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Tene tene vyũ kwaĩ mũndũ ũmwe ngya na mũka wake. Maĩna kana kamwe ka kelĩtu ketawa Nokũngũ.

Nokũngũ aĩ mwanake na mũthingu.

Asyai make nĩmamwendete mũno.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Mũthenya ũmwe asyai make nĩmavangie kũmũtwaa kwa naũme wake mũthui wetawa Mũtonyama.

Inya nĩwamũseũvĩsye kĩsikati kĩseo kĩna malaa na ivungo na wanyũa.

Nĩwamũseũvĩsye ĩsoa ya wanyũa na ĩndĩ amũtũma ndũanĩ ya naũme.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Aendete Nokũngũ nĩwethĩie kalũsĩ na akakĩla akinyangĩte mavia.

Mũingo Nokũngũ nĩwakomanie na kelĩtu kanini kekĩte ilai.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Kelĩtu nĩkamũkũlilye, “Wendete kũ?” “Nendete kũkethya mama Mũtonyama,” Nokũngũ nĩwasũngĩie “Onakwa Mũtonyama nĩ mama na nendete kũmũkethya,” kelĩtu nĩkaisye.

Kwou nĩmatembeie vamwe.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text: Mendanga vanini kelĩtu nĩkaisye, “kĩsikati kyaku nĩkĩseo mũno na ĩsoa yaku nĩyanake, vatonyeka nenge nele.” Nokũngũ nĩwaumisye kĩsikati na ĩsoa yake na anenge kala kelĩtu.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Ĩla kelĩtu kau kaumisye ilai syako nakekĩa ngũa sya Nokũngũ, Nokũngũ nĩwonie kelĩtu kena mwĩthe!

Nokũngũ nĩwew’ie w’ĩa nũndũ nĩwamanyie kelĩtu kau nĩyalyũka.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text: Nĩmatembeangie vamwe na Nokũngũ asya, “ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.” Ĩndĩ yalyũka nĩyaisye, “eka nĩkĩange nginya tũvike mũtĩnĩ ũya.” Nĩyaolotile mũtĩ wĩ kĩĩmanĩ.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Ĩla mavikĩĩe mũtĩ ũsu, Nokũngũ nĩwaisye, “ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.”

“Mbekee tu nĩkĩange nginya tũvike kalũsĩnĩ kala katĩe,” yalyũka nĩyaisye. Nokũngũ nĩwetĩkĩlile nũndũ nĩwakĩaa.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Nĩmavikie kala kalũsĩnĩ na Nokũngũ eea yalyũka, “vatonyeka ndũngĩe kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa.”

“Mbekee tu nĩkĩange nginya tũvike kanyũmbanĩ kaala vala iveti isu syile nthĩ,” yalyũka nĩyaisye.

Kwou nĩmaendie na mbee.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Ĩla mavikie kanyũmbanĩ yalyuka nĩyalutile Nokũngũ ĩtina na yeya iveti ila syaile vau, “syisyai kelĩtu kaa kekĩte ilai. Kambatĩe mũthenya mũima na nenda kasyoke.”

Nokũngũ nĩwakwatiwe ni nzoni na asemba evitha kyũũnĩ.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Yalyũka nĩyendie nyũmbanĩ ya Mũtonyama na yamwĩa “ninyie mwĩvau Nokũngũ. Asyai makwa mambĩie nũke kwĩkala naku.”

Mũtonyama nĩwathokisye mwĩĩtu ũsu na andũ make mekala nesa na ũthingu na ĩla yalyuka. Ĩndĩ Nokũngũ ekalaa kyũũnĩ na kũya lĩu wa ngitĩ.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Kwi mũthenya Nokũngũ endaa mũũndanĩ akwĩvitha mbembanĩ na akw’ina:

“Thĩna atĩ thĩna nyie. Natũmiwe nĩ tata na inya nũke kwĩkala na mama Mũtonyama. Nzĩanĩ nakomanie na yalyũka na yoosa kĩsikati kyakwa na ĩsoa yakwa. Thĩna atĩ thĩna nyie.”

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Mũthenya ũmwe mwanainyaa Mũtonyama ũmwe akĩtembea mĩundanĩ nĩwew’ie wathi ũsu mũseo na wa tei.

Ndamanya vala wathi ũsu waumaa ĩndĩ avika mũsyĩ nĩwatavisye Mũtonyama ndeto sya wathi ũsu.

Mũtonyama ew’a ũu nĩwendie mũũndanĩ na.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Nokũngũ nĩwamũtavisye ũndũ kwekĩkie, ũndũ yalyũka yamũvenie ngũa syake nzeo na yatumwa ekĩa ilai.

Mũtonyama nĩwamwosie na athi nake kwake nake na amũvitha nyũmba nzĩnĩ.

Mũtonyama nĩwesĩ ũndũ ũkũkwatya yalyũka.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Mũtonyama nĩwew’ĩte kana mwĩthe wa yalyũka nĩwendete ĩia na ndwamba kũtia ĩia ũtanywĩte ĩmwe.

Kwou nĩwatavisye aũme make masimbe ĩima ĩnene na makwĩyusũsya na ĩia ĩwaatu.

Nĩwetie eĩtu onthe ma ndũa moke masindane kũtwĩla.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Mwĩĩtu ũla wekĩĩte ngũa sya Nokũngũ nĩwakwatiwe nĩ kĩthikii.

Ndendaa kũtwĩla ĩũlũ wa ĩla ĩima nũndũ nĩwesĩ mwĩthe wake ũkew’a waũni wa ĩia.

Kwou nĩwalikile nyũmba na oveanĩsya mwĩthe na mwĩĩ wake alũmya ũndũ vatonyeka.

Na ĩndĩ nĩwendie kũlikana na eĩtu ala angĩ.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Eĩtu nĩmanzie kũtwĩla ĩũlũ wa ĩima ũmwe ĩtina wa ũngĩ.

Ĩla ĩvinda ya yalyũka yavikie nĩyatatie kũtwĩla ĩla ĩima ĩndĩ mwĩthe wayo nĩwathalĩkile waĩkusya, waĩkusya, waĩkusya, mũvaka ĩla ĩianĩ ĩwatu.

title: 0251_nokungu-na-yalyuka.md
text:
Yalyũka yendee na kwilita ĩianĩ ĩsu ĩwatu aũme nĩmosũisye ĩima na kĩthangathĩ na mathika yalyũka.

Na ũsu nĩw’o waĩ mũthya wa yalyũka.

Ĩndĩ Nokũngũ nĩwekalile nesa na naũme kwa kĩlungu kĩasa.

Ngewa yathelela vau.

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Niki mwana ukuia?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Nikwathya ena nzaa.

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Niki kivisi ni kithatu?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text:
Nikwatya kina mea ma
ithe.

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Niki kelitu ni katanu?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Kena ilinda yeu.

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text:
Niki mutumia mukuu
ukutheka?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text:
Nusomie kindu kya
uthekya.

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text:
Niki mundu muka
ukukenyeesya itheka?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text:
Niki mundu muka
ukukenyeesya itheka?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Mundu muka ew’a ata?

title: 0265_ndavye-oyu-utanu-na-kimako.md
text: Nikwatya ewa nzoni.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text: Ũũ ni Ngi.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text: Ũũ nĩ mũtwe mũnene.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
Ngi and Mũtwe mũnene
maĩ ndũũ. Mũthenya
ũmwe nĩmaendie
kũtembea.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
Nĩmavikie ngũkanĩ ya
ũsĩ na manzĩĩa
kũkananĩsy.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
“Ndwamba kũkĩla ũsĩ
ũũ!”
“Nonĩkĩle. Niwe
ũtakĩla!”

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
Ngi nĩwaisye, “we
twĩla!”
“Aiee, we twĩla mbee,”
Mũtwe mũnene
nĩwaisye.
Kwou Ngi nĩwolũkile
akĩla ũsĩ ũsu.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
Mũtwe mũnene
nĩwatwĩlie ũsĩnĩ. Ĩndĩ
nũndũ mũtwe wake waĩ
mũnene ndaalela;
nĩwanzĩĩe kw’indanw’a
nĩ kĩw’ũ.

title: 0287_ngi-na-mutwe-munene.md
text:
Ngi nĩwathekie,
“he,hee!”
Ĩndĩ athekie mũno
mũvaka kanyw’a wake
waatũka miondo ĩlĩ.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Sũsũ aĩ vakuvĩ mĩaka mĩongo
mwonza. Aĩ mũthangaau. Mũũndanĩ
kwake avandaa mũvya, mwee,
manga na maiũ. Sũsũ akethaa maiũ
kĩla ĩvinda ya mwaka.
Grandma’s garden was wonderful full of sorghum, millet, and cassava.
But best of all were the bananas.
Although Grandma had many
grandchildren, I secretly knew that I
was her favourite. She invited me
often to her house. She also told me
little secrets. But there was one
secret she did not share with me:
where she ripened bananas.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Sũsũ aĩna syana mbingĩ. Ĩndĩ katĩka
onthe, nyie na aamwaiya na
eetwiya kwa kĩmbithĩ nĩtwesĩ sũsũ
nũtwendete kũvĩta ala angĩ.
Nau nĩwe waĩ ĩlumaita ya sũsũ kwou
sũsũ atũkua kwa nzĩa ya mwanya.
Kwa ngelekany’o nĩwokaa mũsyĩ
kwitũ mavinda maingĩ. Ĩla ena nau
na mwaitũ nĩmathekaa mũno. Na
kĩngĩ nowatwĩtaa nyũmba kwake
mavinda maingĩ. Ĩũlũ wa syĩndũ
syonthe sũsũ nĩwatũtavasyaa
syĩmbithĩ syake ĩndĩ ve kĩmbithĩ
kĩmwe ũtatũtavya: vala waindĩa
maiũ make.
Mũthenya ũmwe nĩnonie kĩkavũ kya
malala kiĩtwe suanĩ nza wa nyũmba
ya sũsũ. Ĩla nakũlilye nĩ kyakĩ
nanengiwe ũsũngĩo ũmwe kana nĩ
kĩkavũ kya syama. Sũsũ anzũngĩa
ou nĩwendee kũalyũla kĩtembe kya

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Vakuvĩ na kĩkavũ vaĩna mathangũ
ma maiũ wekalaa akwalyũla ĩvinda
kwa ĩvinda. “Mathangũ asu nĩmakĩ
sũsũ?” nĩnamũkũlilye na anzũngĩa
“aa nĩ mathangũ makwa ma kwĩka
syama.” Mũminũkĩlyo, sũsũ
nĩwombĩanĩe maiũ onthe ala maĩ
nyekinĩ.
Kyaĩ kĩndũ kya kwendeesya kwona
sũsũ, ĩiũ ĩnene matũ ma maiũ na
kĩkavũ kya malala kĩnene. Onew’a
nĩnendaa kwĩloela nĩmanye ũndũ
sũsũ ũkũtũmĩa syĩndũ isu syonthe,
sũsũ nĩwandũmie ngeete kĩndũ
kuma vala ve mwaitũ.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Ndililikana kĩndũ kĩu kyaĩ kyaũ.
Nĩnamwĩsũvie ngũmwĩa, “Sũsũ naku
eka nambe kwona wĩsovya....” “Eke
kwĩthĩwa kana keemu, ĩka ũndũ
watavwa.” Sũsũ nĩwasũngĩie.
Nĩnaumie nĩsembete.
Nasyokethya nethĩie sũsũ ailye nza
wa nyũmba. “Sũsũ, kĩkavũ kĩva na
maiũ na...?” ĩndĩ ũsũngĩo ũla
nakwatie nĩkana, “Syĩvandũnĩ
vakwa va syama.” Nĩnendaa
kũmanya vandũ vau va syama ĩndĩ
namũkũlya sũsũ nĩwendee
kwĩtwĩkĩthya kana ndakwĩw’a na
aendea kw’ina wathi. Nĩnakwie
ngoo.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Matukũ elĩ mathela sũsũ aĩna mĩtũkĩ
ya kũthi mũkutano ndũanĩ.
Nĩwandũmie ngamwosee ndata
yake lumunĩ ya kũkoma. Ĩla
navingũie mwango wa lumu ĩsu
nĩnathokiswe nĩ muuke wa maiũ
makwĩw’a.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Lumunĩ ya nzĩnĩ ĩũsũĩte syĩndũ sya
sũsũ nĩvo vaĩna kĩla kĩkavũ kya sũsũ
kya syama kĩvĩthĩtwe nĩ ĩvula ĩkũũ.
Nĩnavwĩkũie ĩvula na muuke wa
maiũ wongelekela. Wasya wa sũsũ
nĩwandelemilye akwasya, “wĩka ata
we? Ngalatĩle ndata yakwa.”
Nĩnamũsembeesye ndata na
angũlya, “nĩ kyaũ ukwetye kwenyea
kũtheka?” Ĩkũlyo yake nĩyatumiswe
ngũmanya kana nonendee
kwenyeea ĩtheka nũndũ wa
kũmanya vala vandũ va syama.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe sũsũ ooka
kũnena na mwaitũ nĩnosie
kamwanya ka kũsemba nyũmbanĩ
kwake ngasisye maiũ ĩngĩ. Vaĩ
kĩtembe kĩmwe kyew'ĩte vyũ.
Nĩnaumisye ĩiũ ĩmwe na navitha
ĩlindanĩ. Natũngĩa kĩla kĩndũ
nĩnasyokie nyũmba na naya ĩiũ
yakwa na mĩtũkĩ. Ndyaya ĩiũ yany’a
mũyo ũu ĩngĩ!

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe nĩnetelile sũsũ
athi kuuna mboka nasemba kũsisya
ala maiũ. Vakuvĩ onthe nĩmew’ĩte.
Ndyenamba kũmĩĩsya kũlea kwosa.
Nĩnosie ana na nekalata kuumala
nolwa kũvwĩka kĩkavũ.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Nuumalĩte kavola na mĩthya ya
syaa sya maaũ Nĩnew’ie sũsũ
akũkoa vu nza. Nĩnatatie kũvitha
maiũ asu ĩlindanĩ. Namina kũya
nĩnasyokie na wethĩa sũsũ
ndanamanya mĩvango yakwa.
Mũthenya ũla watĩĩe waĩ wa
ndũnyũ. Sũsũ nĩwokĩlile tene nũndũ
kĩla wa ndũnyũ nĩwatwaa maiũ meu
na manga kũta. Ndyekalata kũthi
kũmũkethya mũthenya ũsu. Ĩndĩ
ndyenamba kũmwĩvitha kĩlungu
kyaasa.

title: 0294_maiu-ma-susu.md
text:
Masaa ma wĩyoo ĩla netiwe nĩ
mwaitũ na nau na sũsũ nĩneesĩ kĩla
ngwĩtĩwa. Ũtukũ ngũkoma nĩneesĩ
kana ndikang’ea kĩndũ kya sũsũ
kana kya asyai makwa kana kya
mũndũ ũngĩ.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Ivinda ya tene kwai mundu wai na kila kindu – muunda munou, wai na ngombe, malondu na
mbui. Na aendee na ukua andeea kwithiwa na kimako, nundu ndai na kindu kimwe. Ndai
muka.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Aungamite ungu wa muti muthenya
umwe aukiwa ni ivindisya iseo.
Kethiwa ndona kiveti ai atonya
usovya kimwe?

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kwou ambia kuseuvya kiveti
kyanake kumana na uvonge wa
muti.
Ila waminie kuseuvya ivisa, akita
metho mayo na mavinguka.
Aivevea na yethiwa na thayu.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kwaw’o kyai kiveti kyanake
utakyona vandu vangi.
Atulya ndu mbee wakyo to akikulya
ethiwe mume wakyo.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Akinenga ngua nzeo, wanyua na
mbete ya mutwe kwonanya kyai
kiveti kitwae. Na akyakia nyumba
ya ndaka na nyeki ila yai vakuvi na
kitina kya muti vala kyaumie.
“Nikukulya kindu kimwe kwatei”.
Atavya kiveti kyake.
“Ndukaatate utavya mundu vala
waumie”.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kwa kavinda kavuthu, aume ma
muika kuma utuini ungi mambiia
kuneena. “Mundu mukuu ta usu
atonya kwithiwa na kiveti kya muika
kyanake uu ata? Mavanga kukyosa
na kukitwaa kyuuni kyoo”.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Mukuu uu niwethiwe na kyeva
muno.
Ndai atonya kwikala thayu atena
kiveti kiu.
Ateo avindisya yingi, “Ethiwa nina
kindu kyake ndyaile ni kumaka”.
Kwou atuma mavui, kukimantha,
kukinia, na kumwetee o kindu kuma
kwakyo.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Ila makyonie, makiniie kwa
kithyomo kya nyunyi.
Kiveti kya muti kiveti kya muti,
Kiseo kitemoneka. Mwimiu
nututumie tumutungie ngua yaku.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kya manenga ngua yakyo, na mauluka iulu wa iima, mbusi, maendete kula kwi muume
wakyo.
Akwatie ngua yakyo vakuvi na uthyu na eewa muyo vanini.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Wendi wake uyathela mituki.
Niwatumiie mavui ingi makinie.
Kiveti kya muti, kiveti kya muti
kiseo kitemoneka, mwimiu
nututumie tumutungie mbete yaku
ya mutwe.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Akwete mbete ya mutwe
athumuuka nundu wa kiveti kyake
kikuasa kyuuni kya andu angi.
Kwa kavinda, eeta mavui make ingi.
Thyiuuthi kula kii mukaine, kiveti
kya muti kiveti kya muti kiseo
kitemoneka muimiu niatutumie
tumutungie thayu wake!

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kwou mathi ivinda ya katatu.
Mavuila ituoni syakyo.
Mainite, kila isuni yatonga itho
mituki kyatwika ivisa. Maau na
moko mavaluka na mutwe. Na
kyavaluka muthangani.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Kavola muume avingilitya kitina kya
muti usini.
Akyungamya na mii yakyo kiwuni.
Nundu wa isua na muthanga,
kyamesya matu ingi.

title: 0297_kiveti-kya-muti.md
text:
Na ukungi wikwo matu nimaumasya
wasya.
Otondu kiveti kikaa kikwenda
muume.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Mbui,Ngiti na Ng'ombe
mai anyanyae
anene.Muthenyia umwe
maendie kyalo na ngali.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Mavika kwisho wa
kyaloi,Ndeleva amea
maive tikiti.Ng'ombe
aiva tikiti wake.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Ngiti aiva tikiti
umwingaingi,nundu
ndaii na mbesa ila
syailite.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Ndeleva akwenda
utungia Ngiti mbesa sya
uluui,Mbui aumela
asembete ataivite
kindu!

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Ndeleva athata
muno.Atwaa ngali
atanatungia Ngiti
mbesa sya yuulu.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Ni kwio kitumi ona
umunze Ngiti usembea
ngali
akunikile nzini aimaza
Ndeleva ula
utamutungia mbesa
syake sya yuulu.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Mbui nake asembaa
aitoloka muumo wa
ngali.Ethia aikia
ndakakwatwe nundu wa
ulea iva tikiti wake.

title: 0315_mbui-ngiti-na-ngombe.md
text:
Na Ng'ombe
ndatelemaa ngali
yukite.Ng'ombe osaa
ivinda yake kukilanilia
nzia nundu niwaivie
tikiti wake wonze!

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Kyai kiwiyoo kivyu kya wathanthatu mwei wa ikumi na ili. Kila umwe ai muthatu. "Bontle na Mpho na Leroto, umalai muthauke" Mme atutavya. "Ndi kumwenda vakuvi nakwa."

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Twaumaaluka tusembete. "Tuthii usini" Loreto atutavya. "Vau ni vathithangu." "Indi Mme atwia twikativie usini" Bontle atutavya " Tuyitivia" Leroto asungia. "Tuthauke munyini vakuvi na kiwu."

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Ateo ithau ya 'libeke' ni ivyu ona ethiwa wi ungu wa miti vakuvi na usi. Mbee twaumya syaatu. Indi twai o avyu. Twaumya sati na sikati. Indi twai o avayu.

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Twekia maau usini mathithe. Na twombangana kiwu. Mituki twamena kiwu.

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: "Inywi nenyu! Tutiviei" Asya Mpho. "Mme ndakamanya" Twativia na twativia nginya twolwa ni ivinda.

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Sua yambiia kuthua na twambiia kwiwa mbevo ngua situ syaiva?

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Twamantha ungu wa miti. Twamantha kithekani Twamantha kila vandu.

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Ateo vai ngombe syai vakuvi na usi sikuya nyeki syai muyo. Bontle asisya iulu! " Sisya ngombe iya! Yumite kyau? "Iya ilaa itune" Lerato asya."

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: "Ti ilaa itune" Mpho atulya wasya. "Ni sati yaku" Twasisya ngombe ingi yutanyuka kindu ki mbuluu. "Isu ni skati yakwa" Bontle atulya wasya.

title: 0322_kiwioo-kimwe-kivyu-kya-wathanthatu.md
text: Twenukie na ngua sya nthini tutetema nikwithiwa kwai na uthithu. "Ni ngombe" Twasya, ngombe nisyosyaie ngua situ Mme niwatwikiiie? Mituki itimba situ syavyuva. Na ti undu wa isua.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Vau tene, vai iimu ika.
Muthenya umwe yiitembea vakuvi
na iia niyonie twilitu tutatu tunini.
Yatukulya “nuu kati wenyu
wendetwe ni asyai onthe.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Kelitu kamwe kasya “mwaitu
ambendete muno”
Kangi kasya “Tata ambendete
muno”
Kakatatu kasya, “nendetwe ni asyai
onthe”.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Iimu yeya kelitu kala kendetwe ni
asyai onthe kayaikye ngu mwongo.
Kwoou kelitu katiia iimu.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Maendanga vanini, kelitu kakulya
iimu “ngu syaku syiva” Iimu
yasungia, “vakuvi na mii iyaa”.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Mavika mitini, kelitu kakulya ingi “
ngu syaku syiva?” Iimu yasungia
kana mangie uvika.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Maenda na makomana na mundu
ula wakulilye iimu “ kana kaku
ketewa ata” Iimu yasya “Ketawa
muvuko unenaa”.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Kelitu katheka muno na kaina
Tinye muvuko unenaa
Nitawa Kaamungei
Uui mwaitu numbendete
Uui – tata numbendete
Ui, kikuu kyakwa
Ninywiaa iia.

title: 0326_muvuko-unenaa.md
text:
Ila mundu wewei kelitu undu kaina,
akataanany’a na akatungia asyai
mako.
Ukewa wathelela vau!

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
Ivinda ya tene, tene vyu, vee
mbuavui weetawa Anansi. Kiveti
kya Anansi kyai muui museo. Ateo
kila ivinda, Anansi niwendaa weuni
kusamasama liu ula andu utuini
mayauaa vamwe na misyi yoo.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
Muthenya umwe avitila kwa
Mbaluku. Kavaluku ai munyanyae.
“Ve mboka mbisuni” Anansi aneena
ewite muyo. Anansi “syinamba
kuvya” kavaluku amutavya, “ateo
nisyuvya mituki, eteela tuye
vamwe”.
“Nindonya kwendeew’a ateo nina
syindu ngwika,” Anansi asya na
mituki. Ukethia etelile ethiwa
aneewa wia eke ni kavaluku.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
“Ninisi” Anansi aweta. “Ningwaka
ulwalui. “Ningwovea ulwalui umwe
kuuni kwakwa na ungi mbisuni
yake, liu wavya kusya ulwalui umwe
na ninguka nzembete!” Mbaluku
oona uu ni useo na awika.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
“Ningwiw’a mboso syunyunga,”
Anansi aneena atembeete. “Mboso
syina muyo, syi mbisuni syuvya.”
Uka tuye mboso situ”, makuli
mamutavya.”syangiie kuvya.”.
“Nindonya kwendeew’a Tata nguli,”
Anansi asya. Na ingi asya ni
ukuseuvya ulwalui na oveye umwe
kuuni na uungi wovewe mbisuni
nene ya mboso.
Tata Nguli niwoonie kana uu wai
useo na awika.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
“Niwa makwasi mainyunga” Anansi
aneena ena muyo atembeete. “
Makwasi na uki wa nzuki,
ningwisilya.
“Anansi”, munyanyae kithangaite
amwita. “Mbisu yakwa yusuite
makwasi na uki wa nzuki! Uka
tuisanie”
“Nonendeewe” Anansi na ingi asya
nukuseuvya ulwalui na umwe
wovewe kuuni kwake na muthia
ungi wovew’e mbisuni ya makwasi.
Munyanyae kithangaiti oona uu ni
useo na eeka w’o.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
Ivinda ila Anansi wavikie usini aina
ulwalui wovewe mau make nyanya.
“Uu ni undu u useo” Anansi aiya
ena muyo. “Ndyisi ni mbisu yau
ikuvya mbee.
O saa isu Anansi eewa ulwalui
umwe wakitwa. “Oo”, Anansi
atumua, “Usu ni ulwalui ula wovewe
mbisuni ya mboka sya mbaluku”.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
Ew’a ulwalui ungi. Na ungi. Anansi
akuswa kundu kutatu ivinda yimwe.
“Auaa” Anansi atumua ila wewie
ulwalui wa kana wakuswa. Osaa isu
eewa ulwalui wa kataano wakuswa.
Na wathanthatu . Na wa muonza.
Anansi akuswa ngali ii na iya, kila
umwe aikusya. Maau make
makuswaa nginya mathekeva na
mathekeva.

title: 0329_kitumi-kya-anansi-kwithiwa-na-maau-matheke-nyanya.md
text:
Anansi avingilita alika kiwuni. Ila
molwalui oonthe matwaiswe ni
kiwu, asyoka yingi akwiwa woo
ngukani. “ai, ai, ai, ai”, Anansi,
avevuuka, “ Nikwatya uu ndwii
undu useo, ona vanini “ Kuvikia
umunthi mbuavui Anansi ethiwa na
maau nyanya matheke muno. Na
muthenya usu ndaakwata liu ona
umwe.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Ĩvinda ya tene na tene,
vaĩna musyĩ wekalaa na
ũtanu.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Mayaũkitanaa ene kwa
ene. Nimatetheesyaa
asyai moo musyĩ na
mĩundani.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Ĩndĩ mayanengetwe
mwanya wakũthi vakuvĩ
na mwaki.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Maĩlĩte kũthũkũma wĩa
woo w’onthe ũtukũ.

Nũndũ mĩĩ yoo yaseovetw’e na mũvũa!

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Ĩndĩ mwana ũmwe aĩ na
mea ma kũthi nza
kwĩanĩkĩa kyeni kya sua.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Mũthenya ũmwe
nĩwethĩiw’e na mea asu
ma kũthi nza muno.
Ĩndĩ aamwanainya
nĩmamũkanisye...

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Ũũi! Mwana ũsu
ndaatetheka.
Nĩwanyinyũkie nũndũ
wa ũvyuvu wa sua.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Syana sya mũvũa
nĩsyakwatiwe ni kyeva
nũndũ wa kwona
mwanaainya
ainyinyuka.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Ĩndĩ nĩmethĩiw’e na
mũvango. Nĩmosie
mũndo wa mũvũa ula
wanyinyukie maseovya
kasũni.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Nĩmosie mwanaainya
kasũni mamũlĩsya ĩũlu
wa kĩĩma kĩtũlu.

title: 0337_syana-sya-muvua.md
text:
Na sua ĩkuuma
nĩwolũkile athi kũu
akwina kyeninĩ kya
kĩoko.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Kwa ivinda iasa, Olokwango
aungamite akenyesya itheka
katikati wa uii wa kwene. Kuma
Malong’ola eli ngali syonthe ili,
vaumite mbusi ila syakomanite
miandani kuseuvya usi. Usi wa
Temu wavitilite uini wa Kweni
ukilitye ki. Kiwu kyaw’o kyai
kinengo kwa ng’ombe, matunda na
mbui sya utuini ovamwe na Nzia ila
yekalaa uini usu.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Maundu maendee nesa muvaka ila
Matata watwikie mutui. Aisye nzia
niseuvwe isilite kiimani nikana
alisae kiimani vate thina wa
uvingilita mbika nthi kavola. Kiima
kya Olokwango nikyathatie muno,
nundu wa kwanangwa kwa
king’ewa kyake ateo kyaumisya.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Muthia wa kyumwa, syana sya
Matata na anyangae moo nimalisaa
kiimani kuthauka. Masembaa kila
vandu, maitulanga mbonge sya
miti, makyakany’a miaki na kumitia
yakene.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Kwa ivinda Olokwango anoa. Kavola
aeka kukenyeesya itheka.
Malong’ola maendeea na unyiva na
uthyu wake waendeea na
ukunzana. Mwisio ila mbusi ili
syang’ala. Nguka sya usi wa Temu
syasianisya kwa kimako. Nzia ila
syai uini syathama nundu vayai
nyeki ndaasa, ithaukia na vandu
vavinyu vaukoma. Ng’ombe, mbui
na malondu syamosa vyu. Kila
umwe eew’a kimako kya kiima kya
Olokwongo.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Andu ma Kwere nimamanyie kana ve kindu kikwenda
kwikwa. Nimakwatanie na maumya Matata kivilani.
Vandu vake manyuva Baraka ula mituki waisye kila
mundu navande ilaa manenge Olokwongo ndaia.
Baraka na andu make maseuvya sikuku na maete
mithinzio ya miti ya maana kwa Olokwongo.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
Vai mundu watenbeelaa kiimani kiu
na nyeki yamea yingi. Kwa kavola
itheka ya kiima kya Olokwongo
yaingiva na malongola malikanga.
Kuma malongolani asu mbusi
syaumila ingi. Usi wa Temu
wathayuuka. Mbii syatwika sya
kisunzuni nundu wa miti na nyeki.
Nzia syambiia kusembasemba ingi
ku nyekini. Ng’ombe, mbui, na
malondu syathumua munyini wa
miti.

title: 0340_kuthaukywa-kwa-utanu.md
text:
“Ikala thayu mwasa Baraka, ikala
thayu mwasa Baraka” andu ma
Kwere maina. “Ikala thayu mwasa
Olokwongo” Baraka na andu masya.
“Syana syenyu na syana sya syana
syoo na nzukulu syoo nisyunenge
ndaia kila ivinda.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga ekalile na asyai make
nginya metwa emĩaka ĩkũmi.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kĩveti kĩmwe kya mũkonyo woo
kyetawa Losa nĩkyamwosie kyathi
kwĩkala nake mũsyĩ kwakyo.
Losa aĩngya na mũkũũ ĩndĩ
aĩmũthingu.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga mavinda maingĩ nĩwendaa
tũvulĩnĩ twa asyai make kũmatavya
mathĩna make.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Mũthenya ũmwe ĩla Kayanga
wendie kwona tũvulĩ nĩwanengiwe
mũthĩnzĩo mũseo wa kĩkuu kya
mwanya Kyaumĩlile tũvulĩnĩ twa
asyai make.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kĩkuu kĩu nĩkyanie wathi mũseo na
wa ũkiakĩsyo. Kayanga nĩwamanyie
kana wasya ũsu nĩwa inyaake.
Wathi ũsu wendaa ta ũũ...

Kayanga, ee, Kayanga!
Mwanawitu nĩtwakwendete!
Ndwĩweka mwendwa!
Osa kĩkuu kĩĩ mwendwa!
Kĩkuae kĩla vandũ mwendwa!
Kakĩkũkiakĩsye mwendwa!

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga akuaa kĩkuu kĩu kĩla vandu
vonthe wendaa.
Nũndũ wa kĩkuu kĩũ Kayanga
nĩwew’aa eũsũvĩonĩ wa asyai make.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Mũthenya ũmwe kĩndũ kĩthũku
nĩkyekĩkie. Kĩkuu kyake
nĩkyatũkanie ĩla wendie kũutĩa kĩw’ũ
ũsĩnĩ.
Kayanga nĩwew’ie ngoo yake onayo
nyatũka.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga nĩwakwatie ilungu sya
kĩkuu kĩkuu mokonĩ make manini na
aina:

Nau na mwaitũ
Onai kĩkuu nĩkyakw’a
Kĩkuu kĩla mwanengie.
Nĩkaata, nau na mwaitũ?
Ĩthĩwai athingu namwĩmbony’a kyama...
Kana mwĩovamwe nakwa.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga nĩwew’ie wasya wainya
ũkĩmwĩa:
Mwanawitũ,
Osany’a ilungu isu syatiwa.
Tava kĩw’ũ nasyo nawĩthamba
maaũ.
Wamina kũthamba vinga metho
maku.
Kayanga nĩwekie ũndũ wataviwe na
kwa mĩtũkĩ ilungu isu nĩsyetungĩanĩe
syasovya kĩkuu kĩima ĩngĩ.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Kayanga nĩwaendee kũkua kĩkuu kĩu
kĩla vandũ waendaa. Kĩla vandũ
vonthe wesĩlaa andũ nĩmaseng’aa
na kũmũkũlya kĩkuu kĩu
nĩkyamũthemba mwaũ nũndũ
mayaona kĩngĩ ta kĩu ĩngĩ.
Kĩkuu kĩu kyake nĩkyamũnengae kĩla
ũkwenda.

title: 0345_ngewa-ya-kayanga-na-kikuu-kyake.md
text:
Akwĩkala na kĩkuu kĩu kya mwanya
Kayanga nĩwesĩ kana asyai make
nĩmamũsũvĩaa na vaĩ kĩndũ kĩthũku
kĩtonya kwĩkĩka.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni manyatta. Nivo
kwitu. Nyumba yakwa
yi nthini wa kisio kya
Turkana.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni ngamile.
Nthini wa kisio kya
Turkana andu
nimaithasya nyamu syi
kivathukany’o. Ateo
ngamile ni nyamu
yendekete muno.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Aa ni alimu makwa.
Nindete kuthi sukulu.
Sukulu yakwa yitawa
Lolupe.
Ninendete mwalimu
wakwa wa syindu sya
useuvya na moko.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni meli.
Meli ni nene.
Itumikaa kwa kukua
andu na miio kiwuni.
Ngathi Mwambasa ni
kwona meli.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Kii ni kitanda.
Nau wanzeuvisye.
Nikitumiaa na mwinawa
wa munduume. Wiwaa
nesa ukikomee.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni nzamba.
Musyi twi nzamba ili.
Na twi nguku mbiingi.
Nilekasya matumbi
maingi.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni mbia ni nyamu
nzuku ni syisaa liu.
Nisyanangaa ngua.
Nisyetae mowau.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ii ni ngiti.
Ngiti ni nyamu sya
musyi.
Ngiti yiitu yitawa Daa.
Ikumaa muno.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Uu ni mwavuli.
Asyai makwa me
mwavuli munene.
Wina langi mutune,
mbuluu, ilaa ya muuti
na kisunzuni.
Ila kwina mbua,
tutumiaa mwavuli
twikauiwe.

title: 0348_syindu-ila-nisi.md
text:
Ni kilasi kya keli na ninisi syindu mbingi.
Ningwenda kumanya ingi mbingi.
Kila ndesi ngulasya
musyai kana mwalimu.

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Niki itu ni mbuluu?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Ti indi yonthe yithiawa
mbuluu, kana?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Niki matu ni kisunzuni?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Maithiawa me kisunzuni
mavinda onthe.
Kana?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Niki maiu ni ilaa ya
muuti?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Maiu meu mélangi wa
ilaa ya muuti.
Maiu methi me langi wa
kusunzuni.

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Niki myavuli ni nziu?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Myavuli yonthe ti nziu.

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Niki nthakame ni
ndune?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text:
Ve kindu nthakameni
kila kimitwikithasya
ndune.

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Niki munyu ni mweu?

title: 0355_ndavye.oyu-malangi.md
text: Ndyisi.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ ndĩraina.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ arainia gwoko

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ ndĩrahũra hĩ.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ arenogora.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ areta.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ ndĩracokia.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ arathikĩrĩria.

title: 0008_nĩkĩĩ-ureka.md
text: Nĩ kĩĩ ũreka?

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ŭyŭ nȋ Azizi.
Azizi nȋ dolli yakwa.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Nȋnyedete Azizi tondŭ
aikaraga akenete hindi
ciothe.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ndokira kiroko ni ndi
thambaga uthiu.
Gacoka gamwetha
Azizi.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ndamŭona Azizi nȋ
njanŭraga juere yake.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ngȋria kȋroko nȋ ndi
mŭheyaga Azizi.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ndaria thuȋtȋ nȋ ndi
muheyaga Azizi.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Nŭŭ Azizi ndariyaga
thuiti yake.
Nagamaka nȋkȋ!

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Nȋ thiyaga nja gituwaga
mahŭa.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ni heyaga Azizi ihua.
Nŭŭ ndacokagia,
"Ngatho."

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Nȋ ndimuthambagia
agathera mbere ya
mami athambie.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Azizi ndȋmŭȋkagira ngŭo
ndune tondŭ
ninyendete rangi
mutune.

title: 0099_azizi-dolli-yakwa.md
text:
Ndathȋe toro, Azizi
ndȋmŭkomagia
mwenaine haria ndȋ.

title: 0271_igĩrĩ.md
text: Moko manini merĩ ma kũnyita.

title: 0271_igĩrĩ.md
text: Magũrũ merĩ manini ma gũikia teke.

title: 0271_igĩrĩ.md
text: Maitho merĩ manini ma kũona.

title: 0271_igĩrĩ.md
text: Matũ merĩ manini ma kuigua.

title: 0271_igĩrĩ.md
text: Na moko merĩ ma GUKŨMBATĨRIA na wendo.

title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
text:
Uyῦ nῖ mwarῖmῦ
wakwa.
Etagῦo Mwarῖmῦ Njeri.
Ni anyedete mῦno.

title: 0283_mwarimu-njeri.md
text:
Mwarῖmῦ Njeri
athomithagia ndemwa

omudidi.

title: 0348_ebindu-bindmanya.md

Daa.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Khare khare, yatio omukhana
yalangibwa Kalabushe.
Kalabushe yati omukhana
mulomi lomi. Ng'ina Kalabushe
yamukania arekhe khubola

siyaburira tawe.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:

Kalabushe yatirwa nende
bulware. Yamenya lubeka lundi
lwa lukongo lwabu Kalabushe.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Mayi wa Kalabushe yati
adiyikhe ludalo olwo.Yati
musijiambo, ng'ina naberesha
Kalabushe biakhuria airire
shenjenyene mulwaye.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Khunjira Kalabushe yakutana
nende Sinson, Ing'u yati
yekhorere Omundu.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Sinson yamuteba neshina esia
yati akingire.Kalabushe
yamukalusha ati "ne
enyama,mabuyu nde
mabere'.Nyina Kalabushe yati
amukanishe si asunga esia
achinjire ta.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Kalabushe yameta ati
shenjenyene yati mulwaye ni
yati amu irira biakhuria. Sinson
yatsaka khutonya mate,nde
khuekomba enyama ya
Kalabushe yati atsinjire.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Yerukha tsimbiro natsa
munyumba ya senjenyene
Kalabushe.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Yatia shenjenyene Kalabushe
namala yefunikha ribulangeti
riaye.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Kalabushe yola nanyola
inyumba inyirire tsii. Yenjira
mukari nalanga ati "Senje,oti
ena?"

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Nga olwa yakosa khuburira
senjenyene nakalusia, yenjira
musigora owa senjenyene
yakonanga.Yeshindukha
khunyola omundu yefunikhe
ribulangeti likhongo.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
"Senje, khulwa shina matwi kao
nimakhongo muno?" Kalabushe
yateba.Sinson yamu kalusha ati
"khubulire bulayi."

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Kalabushe yateba khandi,
"Senje khulwa shina tsimoni
tsiao nitsikhongo lukari
lero?".Sinson yajiba ati,
"khubone bulayi."

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Kalabushe yamala nateba ati,
'senje khulwa shina omunwa
kwao ni omukhongo?" Sinson
yakalusha ati "Khu khumite."
Sinson yaruka khutula mubutiri
namita Kalabushe

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Khulwa Kalabushe yati omulomi
lomi muno, yatsirira
khulomaloma nari omunda mwa
Sinson. Yateba matebo mangi .

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Lunyuma, Sinson yajong'a nde
matebo ka Kalabushe, ni
yaamua khumu futsa.

title: 0102_kalabushe-mulomi-lomi.md
text:
Kalabushe nende senjenyene
baonisibwa nende bana
Lukongo. Khutsanga inyanga
eyo, Kalabushe yarekha
khuloma loma nende abanandu
ba akolibwe.

text:

nukta kod fuoni mag

text:

osepuoujawa range
kaka makwar, mbulu,
alum, ratong', kod
rateng'.

text:
Seche mag ywenyo,

moudo wanindi.
Adier ower wend nindo
mamit.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Wer mamitno iwero kama:
Nindo mayom ka mula
Yie ichiwne wang'i
Mor mogundho riti
Kawang' ichiewo
Nind maber jaherana
Kik iywagi, kendo wang' awerni
Wend nindo mamit sidang'
Ninda! Ninda!

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:

Oganonwa sigana mopogore pile odiochieng
ka odiochieng ejuma.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Chieng' wuok tich,
oganonwa ewi chuo
mathuondi.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:

e wi nyiri mathuondi.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Tich adek, oganonwa e
wi yore mag wuoth.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Tich ang'wen is
oganonwa ewi wecha
mag pur.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Tich abich to okwayo
moudo wawegi moudo
waganne jowetewa
wawegi.

title: 0283_japuonj-akinyi.md
text:
Adiero japuonjwa ema
oloyo japuonj duto
maniepiny.
Kabedo maduong' to
agomba modo abed
kaka japuonj Akiniyi.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:

Ing’ombe bali abetsa
abakhongo.

oluchendo mumutoka.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Ngala batukha
eshiakamo shio
oluchendo, omwirusi wa
mutoka nabareba
amamondo buli mundu.
Ing’ombe yarunga
amamondo kayo.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Imbwa niirunga amanji
kho khulwokhubera yali
niibula amapesa
akayerana.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Olwa omwirusi wo
mutoka yali ambi
okhuwa Imbwa kali
katonyere, ne Imbusi
niirwatsukha tsimbiro
niishiri okhurunga.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Omwirusi yasinyikha
muno.
Niyerusia mutoka
nashiri okhukalusiria
Imbwa amamondo kali
katonyere.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Esho ne shifune
eshichiranga okhula
lero, Imbwa niilola
mutoka, irenjeranga
mukari khulwokhubera
omwirusi wo mutoka
yatong’a nende
amamondo kayo.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Nayo Imbusi niulire
oluyoka lwo mutoka,
neirukha.
Yaria yakhatirwa khulwo
khukhaya khurunga
amamondo.

title: 0004_imbusi-imbwa-nende-ingombe.md
text:
Nayo I ng’ombe
siyisundukhanga
mutoka nikwitsa tawe.
Ing’ombe ibukulanga
efise fiayo okhukhalasia
omwanda.
Okhubera yamanya
yarunga amamondo
kosi.

text:
Inyanga ndala, Olububi Anansi
yayaba amapwoni okhurula
mundalo ye.
Kali amalayi nomuya okhushila. Kho
yakasamba obulayi mumuliro ne
niyekhala hasi okhukalia.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Kho olwa Anansi yali niyenya okhuluma omunwa kwa
mberi, eshindu shiakhong’o nda khumuliango.
Ngo,ngo, ngo, “Aa ta!” Nabaleka napara. “Oyo anyala
okhuba wina?” Ne niyekula omuliango.
Likhutu nelialiyo, ne lialolekha lichonyire muno.
Nilibola liri, “Anansi, nochama nzikulirakho. Enjendire
oluchendo olurambi muno, mana enjonyire muno
khandi embulira inzala.”
Anansi shiyali nende eshiakhola tawe, alali
okhulikulira?

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Ne Anansi yali omwimani muno oulakhaliire
amapwoni keke amanulu kario nende omundu wundi
tawe; kata omucheni.
Kho nakhola liparo libi. Shinga olwa likhutu liekhala
khumesa nilienya okhuira omukhono okhutola
lipwoni, Anansi nayiiba, “Likhutu, amakhono ko
namachafu. Shonyala okhulia nende amakhono
amachafu kario tawe. Tsia osabe”.
Toto abwene, amakhono ke likhutu kali amachafu,
olwa yali nachenderekho oluchendo olurambi. Kho
likhutu nilimoola nilitsia mumwalo okhusaaba
amakhono, ne khandi nilimoola nilkalukha khumesa.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Ne inyuma naye Anansi nachaka okhumira
amapwoni bwangu bwangu.
Efise fie Likhutu liola khandi, lialola mbu amapwoni
kosi kali nikawere.
Likhutu lialinga Anansi ne niliboola liri. “Orio muno
okhunanga okhuliakho eshiakhulia shie ingolobe.
Niwitsukhanira nyanga wabakho hambi nende inzu
yanje, witsakho siesi ndakhukalusiria orio."
Ne Likhutu nilichaka okhumoola nilikalukha nanzu
walio.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Shinga tsinyanga tsiabura, Anansi yachaka okhupara
shinga Likhutu liamulaka okhutsiakho ewalio okhulia
eshiakhulia eshikhaya shieingolobe. Kho inyanga
ndala yatsia nanzu we likhutu.
Anansi yoola we Likhutu efise fie shiakhulia
shieingolobe shiali ambi, eliuba nilikwitsanga
emwalo. Likhutu liali nilikonere khwichina nilioranga
inengesi, shinga amakhutu kakholanga.
Olwa Likhutu lialola Anansi liabola liri, “Eyi, Anansi,
witsire oliekho eshiakhulia shie ingolobe ninasi?”
Nabaleka naye nakalusia ari, “Habwene, bwakhaba
obulayi muno. Orio muno.” Ne yali nauliranga inzala
niyimetekha.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Kho Likhutu niliyiinikha mumatsi
okhutsia okhwala imesa nende
okhukasia efindu khulweshakhulia
shie ingolobe.
Anansi yalinda khumachina
khulukuku womwalo.
Bwangu obo Likhutu liasoka
khumatsi nilikalukha ne
niliboola,“Oo Anansi, buli eshindu
shimalire okhukasibwa bulano.
Chama witse khulie eshiakhulia.”
Ne Likhutu liyiinikha, nilichaka
okhulia amasafu kaliali nilichinjire
khulwe shiakhulia shieingolobe.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Anansi natema okhwiinikha
okhutsia khulwalo lwo mwalo, ne ye
yali olububi, tawe likhutu.
Shiyakheinishe okhula hasi
khulwalo tawe. Buli eshise
yabenganga nakalukha ekulu
wamatsi.
Yatema okhuruuchiramo, nateema
okhwiyiinikha, ne shifiamukhonya
tawe. Kho shiyanyala okhutsia
okhulia eshiakhulia esho tawe.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Olunyuma Anansi nanyoola liparo.
Yara amachina amanji mumifuko
chie likoti lie, ne nasitoa okhunyala
okhwiyiinikha, okhula khulwalo lwo
mwalo.
Yali omuchesi muno.
Lano nalola imesa ye Likhutu,
niyitsuulekho amasafu kalimo
amatsi amanji amanulu nende
efiakhulia findi efinji efinulu.
Omunwa kwa Anansi kwachaka
okhwitsula amare.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Ne olwa Anansi yayira omukhono
okhutoolakho eshiakhulia shiali
nishinulire, Likhutu nilimwemia:
“Anansi, otsia okhulia nofwalile likoti
orio? Obwatoto shikhukholanga
efindu khurio munzu mwanje muno
tawe”.
Anansi nalaparakho tawe naboola
ari, “Ne abwene toto. Likhutu,
embarirenje shina?” Ne nafwalula
likoti.

title: 0005_anansi-ne-likhutu.md
text:
Ne olwa amachina kamusitoyiinjia
kamurulakho, yachiingukha bwangu
nakalukha khumatsi hekulu khandi,
ne namoola lwangu narula elwanyi
wamatsi.
Anansi yenikha omurwe mumatsi
natsiririra okhulenga Likhutu nililia
efiakhulia efinulu efo fiosi.

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Tsindalo tsia khale abandu
shibali nibamanya okhuraka
emimera ta, nomba okhulukha
tsingubo, nomba okhukasia
efindu fio okhwiranya.
Naye Nasaye womwikulu yali
nende amachesi ko khushialo
kosi.
Yali niyabikha amachesi kosi
munyungu yeliloba.

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Inyanga yindi Nasaye yalola
mbu ayeresie Anansi inyungu
yobuchesi eyo.
Buli olwa Anansi yalinganga
munyungu eyo, yekanga
eshindu eshiyiakha.
Kalinji akokhusangasia muno!

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Okhubera omutolio, Kundu
yapara mbu, “Ndalachikha
inyungu ino ekulu womusala
omurambi womundu wundi
alanyala okhuinyola ta. Kho ibe
eyanje sienyene”.
Yalukha emikoye chiemilandila
naboyera inyungu eyo. Kundu
yeboya omukoye oko
mushibuno shie mana inyungu
eyo niyerera imberi we, mana
niyanza okhunina khumusala.
Fiali efitinyu muno okhunina
khumusala nende inyungu
niyimutuyatuya mumasikamo
buli eshise.

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Anansi yachaka okhusinyikha,
natsunukha tsunukha khandi
nachonya.
Efise fino fiosi omusiani wa
Kundu omutiti yali niyemere
hasi womusala namulinganga.
Naboola ari, “Shi
fiakhabeerekho efiangu
okhunina noboere inyungu
khumukongo okhushira imbeli?”
Kundu nateema okhuboha
inyungu yobuchesi
khumukongo, ne nifilolekha
okhuba efiangu okhushira.

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Yola khumusala hekulu bwangu
muno.
Ne naulera khandi napara.
“Nisie oukhoere okhuba nende
amachesi sienyene. Naye
omwana wanje khandi yashira
arie mumachesi?”
Anansi yasinyikha muno ne
nalekhula inyungu eyo hasi
okhurula khumusala.

title: 0006_anansi-nende-obuchesi.md
text:
Yekhupa hasi niyatikha
efipande.
Nolwa abandu bosi beka
obulimi, okhulukha tsingubo
nende okhwiranya, nende
efindu fiosi efia abandu
bamanya okhukhola.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Nindakhoola emiaka chirano,
papa yamba eshianwa
shichamisia muno.
Shiali akhabwa akhatoro
khamachuma kataru.
Inyanga ya papa umutiti
yakharera nango, ndasangala
muno.
Ndamanya mbu enyolile
omwitsa.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Papa oyo lwayakhara hasi
yandeba mbu , ‘Otsia
okhukhaya lira shi?”
Ndakhalinga ne nemboola mbu,
“Kulukulu.”
Papa oyo niyesundukha
nareeba, “Eshichira nokhalanga
Kulukulu nishi?”
Ndamuboolela mbu,
“Okhubeera khafwana
akhayiimi.”

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Ndareeba papa oyo nikaba mbu Kulukulu
khebulwa khonyene.
Papa oyo naboola mbu akhabwa khandi khosi
akhatoro, khandi akhafwanana nende Kulukulu
khaliyo.
Ndatsia okhulolakho, akhasiani khabu Kulukulu.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Olwa Kulukulu khalolakho
akhasiani khabu, khasangala
muno.
Rwosi rwara emirwe chiabu
alala ngorulomaloma.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Ndareeba papa oyo nikaba mbu
enyala okhufuchililwa okhuruka
rwosi- Kulukulu nende akhasiani
khabu.
“Nobulayi," nakalusia.
"Ne okhuula orulinde obulayi.”
Kho buli ingolobe, ndaruiranga
okhukhola ninarwo emibayo.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Emiesi mititi nichiakhabura,
Kulukulu nende akhasiani khabu
rwali niruli orukhoongo,
rwamani nende obulamu
obulayi.
Rwali orukhoongo muno khulwe
esie okhurulinda khulwanje.

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Bulano ndareeba papa oyo
okhukalusiayo akhasiani khabu
Kulukulu.
Olwa Kulukulu khatong’a
khonyone, khaulila obubi muno.
Khafwana nga khandebanga,
“Mbushina nokhola orio?”

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Khalekha okhubaya. Khandi
efise findi khakhayanga
okhurula nasi okhutsia
okhuchenda.
Efise findi khalitsanga atiti
muno. Ndeparira muno.
Ndereeba, “Shiina shienyala
okhukholakho okhukhonya
kulukulu?”

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Inyanga ndala papa oyo yetsa okhucheniya. Olwa ndaulira
omwoyo kwe, ndarula alwanyi weinzu bwangu bwangu.
Kata neshili okhumulola, ndaulila tsimbwa nitsisema........

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Ndalola inyuma weinzu
yokhutekha, Kulukulu nende
omusiani wabu nitsishina
nobusangali nga khale!

title: 0016_omwitsa-wanje-kulukulu.md
text:
Ndali nobusangali muno, kata
nekhaywa mbu niwina owa
neshesie mbeli. Omusiani wabu
Kulukulu nomba papa oyo.
Ndamanya mbu bulano
Kulukulu yilakalukha nga yali
khale olwa omusiani wabu
akalushe.
Khulatsia okhuyima mundalo
khandi.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Inyanga indi khale, yaliwo omulimi
nende omukhasi we, abali nende
omwana mulala omusiani welira
mbu, Kisirusiru.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Inyanga yindi, Kisirusiru lwayali
nayiranga tsimbusi mushiayo,
olwika lweimbusi lwarandula lishati
lie.
Nyina yaruma Kisirusiru khwiluka
okhukula isindani yetse anabire
lishati waliali nilirandushe.
Yakula isindani ne nara mumufuko
kwe lishati lie.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Olwa yali nakalukhanga nango,
yanyoola abashie nibabayanga
omupira ne nabenjiramo; isindani
yarula mumufuko niilakakha ne
niikora.
Olwa yola nango, yaboolera nyina
eshiali nishikholeshe.
“Mwana wanje,” nyina yaboola,
“olundi, otsomokha isindani
khulukaratasi”. “Yee mama,
embulile,” Kisirusiru nakalusia.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Inyanga yalondakho, musiani nabukula inyungu okhutsia
okhwenda amatsi. Yetsulira elia nyina yali namuboolere,
nafundikha inyungu mushipande shieikaratasi okhuchinga okhuira
nango.

Khunjira ikaratasi eyo niyirandukha ne inyungu niikwa asi,
niyatikha mo efipande. Amatsi nikasundukha nikasalaana asi.
Olwa yoola nango ,nyina yamuira kaala namwechesia, “Mwana
wanje, Olundi notsia musebere, ochinjira inyungu khumurwe, ne
kalatombokha tombokha tawe.”
“Yee embulire mama,” Kisirusiru naboola.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Inyanga yalondakho, samwana
yamuboolera okhuyila tsimbusi
mushiayo.
Yetsulila aka nyina yali
niyamuboolere. Nabukula imbusi
nachinga khumurwe!
Imbusi yamuswala, niyimumanya
khumurwe. Amalasire nikachaka
okhumoola nikasundukha khubweni
bwe.
“Olilekha liina obusirubwo buno?”
Samwana yamureeba noburuma.
“Tsimbusi tsiboyungwa nomukoye
ne tsikhweswa! Nolekhonyera
amachesi ko tawe, olarula munzu
muno.”

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Nibwakhashia, samwana yamuruma
okhutsia okhukula inyama
khushiiro.
Mukhwitsulila aka samwana yali
namuboolere, Kisirusiru yabukula
inyama naboya kho omukoye, ne
niyanza okhuchikhwesa asi natsia
nango.
Yerukha tsimbiro bwangu natsia,
khoyole bwangu.
Paarakho shinga olwa inyama yali
niyifwana olwa yola nango!

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Samwana yasinyikha okhushira ne
namuboolera okhutsia
okhukhung’asia efindu fie fiosi
nende okhurula ango awo.
Nyina, olwa yaulira kho ako, yalola
mbu yesi atsie nende omwana we.
Babukula omuliango kwe inzu
yokhuteekha, nibatsia ninako
okhuchaka okhumbakha litaala
liabu wabatsia.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Bacheenda oluchendo oluraambi ne
shibanyola wabombakha litaala
tawe.
Eshiirima lwa shiatiira, balola mbu
baniine khumusala bakone khu
muliango kwabu.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Olwa bali nibakhaniina busa
khumusala, baulira oluyoka asi
womusala.
Balola emisatsa chisaba
echialolekha okhuba emiri
nichichinjire emikunia emikhoongo.
Besundukha ne omuliango
nikureremukha nikukwa asi.
Kwerula asi, Puuup!, nikusundusia
emindu echo obutinyu, ne
nichilakasia asi buli eshindu,
nichiirukha nichitsia.

title: 0031_kisirusiru-we-eshiyingwa.md
text:
Kisirusiru nende nyina bekha asi
womusala.
Olwa bekula amakunia ako,
banyoolamo amapesa, tsingubo,
amarungeti nende buli eshindu shia
bali nibekomba okhumbashila inzu.
Banyoola abundu wokhumbakha
inzu imbiakha bwangu, nibamenya
nobusangali okhurula olwenolo.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Khale lulia, amayoni kekhala
khushiabusi. Kenya okhuba
nende nabongo wako. Ngala
abandu bali, nende tsisolo.
Liyoni shina elikhoyele okhuba
omwami?

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
"Namunakha, Ikoko Yo Olale. Ali
nende amani khandi afwana
nga nabongo!" Elala niliboola.
"Tawe abula olusimbi, khandi
nalanga alolokhanga
weshibeera," oundi nakalusia.
"Liwuto, okhubeela ne
likhoongo okhushila kosi khandi
nililanga liyibanga nga italanyi,"
elindi niliboolera ekulu
womwoyo.
"Tawe, shilinyala okhupurukha
tawe. Omwami wa amayoni
okhuula abe ounyala
okhupurukha."

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
“Embara mbu nesie oukhoyele
okhuba omwami,” Simbi
nikhaboola,;
nikhashukhasia, shukhasia isuru
yakho. &ldquondi "Endi we
ifwana indayi." "Oli we isunga
inyinji muno," Okuyichichi
naboolera simbi. “Kata kario
shorula mu shialo shiabamali
tawe.”
“Mumayoni kosi nesie ouli
nende tsimoni tsikhoongo.
Ekhoyele okhuba omwami."
"Tawe, ewe tawe, Okuyichichi,”
Kosi nikakwalata. “Otsitsanga
okhukona eliuba nilirula. Mwami
shina oukonanga eshitere?"

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Olunyuma shibanyala
okhunyoola omwami tawe.
Ne mulala niyayulila ekulu,"Ulia
ounyala opurukha yaatsia ekulu
okhushira bosi niye oulaba
omwami."
"Abwene, abwene, "bosi
babolera emioyo ekulu, ne bosi
nibapurukha ekulu, ekulu,
mwikuku.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Liyoyo lia Misri liapurukha
inyanga ndala yonyene, shilunji
okhubura ekulu we fikulu
efirambi fiosi, efili mu shialo
shiosi.
Ikoko Yo Olale, Namunakha
yapurukha khulwe tsinyanga
tsibiri, mumuya mwikulu, ekulu
we efikulu fiosi.
Ne - Ingosia yefwila khulwe
tsinyanga tsitaru tsiosi,
niyichomire khuliuba.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Ne Ingosia niyayula, "Nesie ouli
ekulu okhushira. Nesie
omwami."

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Ne yesundukha olwa yaulila
omwoyo kwowundi ekulu wayo,
"Chirri, chirri, chirri.”
Ekulu womurwe kwe, lialiyo
elala khumayoni amatiiti
mukoosi.
Mulimba, Omupa Ndala. khali
nikhereranga khwibaa elala
liolubaa lwe ingosia.
"Ticki, ticki, ticki,”
nikhafwetetesia. “Nesie owuli
ekulu okhushira. Nesie
omwami."

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Ingosia niyipurukha niyimeta
khandi inyanga yindi
niyininanga busa ekulu. "Nesie
wuli ekulu okhushira koosi.
Nesie omwami," niyayula.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
"Chirri, chirri, chirri! Nisie ouli
ekulu okhushira. Nesie
nabongo," Mulimba Omupa
Ndala nikhaboola.
Abwenao khandi khaliwo,
nikhakhamoola okhurula
mulubaa lwe ingosia.
Ingosia yali niichonyire wa
ilakhanyalile khandi
okhupurukha okhusita imbeli
tawe.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Kario yekha asi, ne ninayo,
Mulimba, yefisa busa mulubaa
lwayo.
Amayoni kandi kali
nikekhoyelenje busa kano koosi,
ne nikasinyikha. Nikakhalinda
busa, nikekasiye okhumanyula
amoya koosi khumubili kwakho.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Ne mubwangu bwakho,
akhayoni akho khalola oburuma
bwa kali ninabwo, ne nikhepiula
mu bwina bweinzukha obwali
obukhaya.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
" Kuyichichi ewe linda busa
abwina awo okhuula nga
kharula nokhatiila,”
nikalachilisia liichichi.
Okuyichichi nikutsia nikwikhala
imberi wobwina.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Ne omubasu kwali
omutundumu. Khulwesho,
bwangu bwangu tsindolo tsisiro
nitsikuyira.
Mulimba, Omupa Ndala,
khalinga elwanyi, ne “z-zip,”
nikhekhwesa nikhabwao.

title: 0037_omwami-wa-amayoni.md
text:
Liichichi liali netsisoni muno
mbu lileshere akhayoni akhatiiti
busa okhukuburakho. Ne
shichila nikuyimanga mushiro
mwonyene. Ne mushitere,
kukona, kuleshe okhulolokha
nende amayoni kandi.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Olwali lwa khale lulia, olwe shialo
shiali nishili eshiyiakha, efikulu
efikhongo fiali nifiafunikha eshialo
ngo oburungeti, ne emisala
emirambi chiatsomosherera hosi
mwikulu.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Mushialo muno, lialiho litiba
liolutungu olurambi nilierima,
niliawulera khandi nilianyira tsi.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Khulwalo lwe litiba lino,
tsialiho tsinzukha tsibiri.
Ndala yali niyakhupa
amakanya kamalwelwe,
ne indi inyerere
niyekotiombola.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Ne inyanga ndala lialiho lirunda
likali. Ikhupa yatulukha niyikhupa
okhula hasi welitiba elo.
Amatsi nikakabukhana khulwe
eshise.
Tsinzukha nitsilola eshialo hekulu,
nende efifwanani fiaukhane halala
nende efilonje fia amabaa.
Amatsi olwa kafunikhao khandi,
tsinzukha shitsiebiririra
amang’ining’ini katsiali nitsilutsi

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
“Shikhunyala okhumenya mwitiba linyifu khandi lierima tititi
lino khandi tawe,” Nitsiboolanira. “Khutsie hekulu khulole
eshialo shiliyo.”
“Khulamenya khurie khu shialo?”

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
“Amayoni komwikulu
shikalakhutsekha okhubeera mbu
khuli hasi tawe. Shikhulamoola
tawe. Khulachenda busa.”
Kaala tsinzukha tsiakanyulukha.
Halala tsiachaka okhwisoka
nitsinina hekulu, hekulu, Khubulafu
bwaliyo.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Ne olwa tsiola khumatsi hekulu,
eshiamakana shiakholekha. Emirwe
chie mishila chiatsio chiatikhamo
khabiri-efilenje nende tsinzala.
Hasi womurwe, amakhono kamera
kabiri nende efikalabo ne tsinzala.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
Shi tsiali tsinzukha khandi tawe, halali omusatsa nende
omukhasi.
Ne olwa balinganakho, nibachamana.

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
“Khulombakha litala liefu mufikulu,” Omukhasi naboola. “Buli
itsuli khulalolanga eliuba nilirula, nilikhutundumia
emikongo..."
“Khularuka obunyasi nende emisala,” Omusatsa naboola.
“Khandi obwitsa nende liyoni nende Isolo.”

title: 0039_omusatsa-wa-mbeli-omukhasi-wa-mbeli.md
text:
“Come," said First Man. “I will,” said First Woman.
And they walked out together into their new world.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Khale khale lialiho lisimba liali
inzala.
Liali nelichendanga ambi
neshitsakha nelikhabanga
shiokhulia.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Nelinyola omukunda kwa
matunda amalayi.
Lialola eshituli shia tsinduli
neshierere khwisaka akulu.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
“Yako kalolekha amalayi,”
Lisimba nilichaka okhwikomba.
Liakalukha inyuma kho linyole
okhuruka akulu obulayi.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Tsinduli tsiali akulu muno.
Ngala liaruka, Lisimba liakwira
omukongo obulali okhunyoola
tsinduli.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Lisimba liabukha nilitsia inyuma
okhubira wa liali nelianzire.
Efise fino liali nende lichomo
okhuruka akulu muno.
Liali ambi okhula akulu nilikwira
omukongo efitinyu muno.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Liakalushira, khandi
nelikalushira alali shilianyalirwa
okhula khutsinduli tawe.
Liakalushira okhukwa okhula
omukongo nokulula muno.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Ngala liakhaywa, liachenda
nelibwao.

title: 0042_lisimba-lieinzala-nende-tsinduli-tsindulu.md
text:
Lisimba siliasangala tawe.
Liema nelilenjera inyuma
neliboola, “Tsinduli etso
tsilolekha tsindulu.”
Liatsiririra okhuchenda. Inzala
yatsiririra okhuliluma muno
okhushira ngala ibere.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Ikwena ili nende ameno
amamemu.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Italanyi yosi ili nende
ameno amamemu.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Inyeni ingali ili nende
ameno amamemu
okhushira.
Ni shichira shina tsisolo
tsindi tsili nende ameno
amamemu?

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Ing'ombe ili nende
ameno ka amani
kokhusia.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Liyoni libula ameno.
Liyoni lilitsanga lirie?

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Tsimbeba tsili nende
ameno amakali ke
imberi.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Siesi ndali na ameno ke
imberi.

title: 0050_ameno-mbia-shi.md
text:
Ameno kanje ke imberi
kakhulikha.
Ewe oli na ameno
kanga?

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Akai olwa yali nashiri
omukhana omutiti,
mama waye
yamukoninjia khwi
liyambo.
Senje waye yakasia
liyambo lilobole lino
khurula khu omunasi.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Liyambo lilitsingi lie
tsirangi tsinyinji
tsindayi.
Liali liaukhana nende
amayambo ka
nyinamwana Akai yali
ninako munzu.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Eshialo shiabotokhana
mungo mwabu Akai
shiali eshiumu, shiayia
nende amachina
ketsula.
Amakhala kali amanji,
tsimbubi nende
tsinzukha tsiosi.

Alali Akai shiyalikho
mumaraba kokhulumwa
nende efilonje efibi fino
tawe.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Mama waye yaboola,
“Liyambo lia Akai
lilobole limuoninjia
okhurula khumaraba.”

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Akai yali omwana
omuchesi.
Yeka womwalo kwaambi
kwolusuba kwali.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Yamanya we inzu ya
kukhu waye yali.
Yatsitsanga
okhusangalira
amabeere ke ingamia
nende kukhu waye.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Inyanga ndala, Akai
shiyali nende ikhabi
tawe.
Yarula okhutsia nanzu
wa kukhu waye alali
shiyanyalirwa okhula
tawe.
Yakorera mufikulu. Yali
nende oburii.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Yekhala hasi wo musala
kweshinikha nalinda
obukhonyi.
Tsindolo tsiamutira
niyanza okhuloora.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Endi nilwo amaloro kali:
Yali nakonire hasi
khwiyambo liaye
lilobole.

Omukhasi wafwanana
nende kukhu waye yali
namulindire.
Omukhasi
yamumwenyera
namweresia ibakuli ya
mabeere ke ingamia.
Olwa yali naira
omukhono okhubukula

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Akai yatimbula tsimoni
kaala.
Olwa yalenga akulu,
yalola eshiyalayal
shiemere khwisaka
akulu waye.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Olwa Akai yema,
eshiyala shiapurupusia
tsimbaa tsiayo ne
shiimisia Akai khunjira.
Yalonda eshiyala.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Akai yola abundu we
tsinjira tsiakabukhana.
Eshiyalayala
shiialakasia eshitonye
shia liyambo,
shifwanana nende shia
Akai.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Okhutola liyambo, Akai
yalola amakulu
kafwanana nende
kanyinamwana.
Yamala alole omwalo
kwolusuba kwa
batayangamo amatsi.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Oluyia lwabo Akai
lwemba nende
okhushina
okhumwinjisia mungo.
Bera imbusi, basamba
inyama ne
nibekhooyera omwana
wabu okhucherera.

title: 0059_liyambo-lilobole-lia-akai.md
text:
Akai yekhala
khwiyambo liaye
nasangalira eshipande
shikali shia inyama
inofu isambe.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Mundalo tsiabura khale, abakhana
bataru batsia okhurenya tsikhwi.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Omubasu kwali nikwakha omululu
pa, kho nibatsia okhwilama
mumwalo.
Belama nibabaya nibaanyulana kho
amatsi mumwalo.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Betsulila mbu efise fiwele.
Nibaalalasia okhutsia ingo.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Olwa bali busa ambi nende ingo,
Prisca nara omukhono kwe mwikosi
lie. Yali niyebirire eshiuma shie!
“Bayie chame khukalusheyo!”
naomberesia abashie.
Nabo abashie nibaboola mbu efise
fiwere muno.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Kho Prisca nakalukha khumwalo
yenyene.
Yanyoola eshiuma shie khandi
nayuchilisia okhutsia nango.
Abula, yakora injira khulwe
eshilima.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Ale kho, yalola obulafu okhurula
mukhatili.
Yayuchilisia okhutsiayo ne
nakhong’onda khu muliango.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Okhumuwuchisia, okubwa
nokwekula omuliango nikumureba,
“Wenya shi?"
“Engorire ne ndikomba mbu
enyoole kho abundu engone.”
“Injira, nomba ekhulume!” okubwa
oko nikumuboolera.
Kho Prisca niyenjira.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Bwangu bwangu okubwa oko
nikumuboolela, “Yalikhao ufuchile!”
“Esie eshili okhufuchilakho imbwa
ta,” Prisca nakukalusia.
“Fuka bwangu nomba ekhunyanye,"
Okubwa oko nikumubuurulira.
Kho Prisca nakufuchila obusuma.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Khandi okubwa oko nikumuboolela
kuri, “Nzalila eshitali!"
Prisca nakuboolela ari, “Esie eshiri
okhwalira kho imbwa ta."
“Nzalila bwangu nomba
ekhunyanye!" Okubwa oko
nikumubuurulira.
Kho Prisca nakwalira eshitali.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Buli nyanga yakufuchiranga nende
okhweya obweru, nende
okhukufuyila okubwa oko.
Inyanga yindi okubwa oko
nikumuboolela kuri, “Prisca, nyanga
ino enzia okhuchendera abetsa
banje.
Yeya inzu, oteshe efiakhulia khandi
ofuye efindu fianje, nendakalukha
tawe."

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Olwa okubwa oko kwali
nikwakhatsia, Prisca yakhunyula
obushinga butaru okhurula
khumurwe kwe.
Yara olushinga lulala mulwalo
weshitali, olundi inyuma wo
muliango, nolundi mulukaka.
Mana niyelukha tsimbilo bwangu
bwangu natsia ewabu.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Olwa okubwa oko kwakalukha,
kwakhaaba Prisca.
“Prisca, oli yena?" nikubuurula,
ng’eee.
“Endi ano, mulwalo weshitali,"
olushinga lwa mbeli nilukalusia.
“Endi ano inyuma womuliango,"
olushinga lwakhabili nilukalusia.
“Nga endi ano, mulukaka,“
olushinga lwa khataru niluboola.

title: 0066_prisca-nende-obushinga-butaru.md
text:
Bulano okubwa oko nikumanya mbu
Prisca yali nakubayire omubayo.
Kho nikwirukha khandi nikwirukha
tsimbiro, okhuula mwitala liabu
Prisca.
Nabo abasiani babu Prisca bali
nibakulindileyo busa nemilabushi
emikhongo.
Okubwa oko olwa kwabalola,
nikushukhana tsimbiro. Ne okhurula
olwenolo, kushiri okhulolokhakho
mwitala omo khandi.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Olukoba lwa Matungu
lwabotokhanwa nende efikulu.
Tsinzukha tsinyinji tsiamenya
mumutsuru khufikulu.
Abamulukoba bakulikha inzukha
ingali Unyalego.
Inzukha yino yarisia abaandu abanji
khubeera yalitsanga tsimbusi nende
amakondi.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
One day, sistersInyanga ndala,
Asitou, Joy nende Sofia bali batsia
mumutsuru okhurenya tsikhwi.
Kukhu wabo yabakanira, “Mwilinde
nende Unyalego. Mulabukule
eshindu shiosi mumutsuru ilali
tsikhwi.”
Joy shiyaulirisia ka kukhu waye ta.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Abakhaana bachinga amabeere,
amaremwa, amapwoni nende
amatsi.
Babukula emikoye chiokhuboya
tsikhwi nende olupanga
lwokhurema emisala.
Bachaka oluchendo okhutsia
mumutsuru.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Khunjira, abakhaana bakhupa
tsimbakha nibatsekha.
Asitou yababoolera, “Bune. Luno no
lukoba lwa Unyalego.”

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Sofia yabalangasia, “Lole, ameno ka
Unyalego kangi’nangi’na.
Khukabukule.
Asitou yabaparisia, “Kukhu
yakanisie khulabukula eshindu
mumutsuru ta ilali tsikhwi.”

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Joy nakalusia, “Kukhu abeeya.
Yaboola ario khubeera shasangalira
khube ne efindu efilayi ta. Ali nende
shikhalikhali. Ndalabukula ameno
kang’inang’ina.”
Abakhaana babo batirwa nende
oburi. “Joy, kukhukaya okhubukula
ameno,” nibaboola. Joy shiyaulirisia
ta.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Mufise fitutu, Unyalego yarula
okhukhaaba ameno kaye.
Yasinyikha muno khubeera
shiyanyoola ameno kaye ta.
Yaulira abakhaana nibapa imbakha
nende okhutsekha. Yefisa
khulwanda hambi nende omuhanda
wa abakhaana bali babire.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Abakhaana betukha tsikhwi
khumirwe chiabo.
Mufise efio, baulira “Hzzzzzzzz!”
Batirwa nende oburi nibatema
okhwifisa. Balola Unyalego
niyasame omunwa, okhwenya
okhubaluma.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Unyalego yareba, “Niwina ubukule
ameno kanje kangi’nang’ina?”
Shibamukalusia ta.
Inzukha iboola, “Ulabukule ameno
ta alemba obulayi. Alatsia nango
nende tsikhwi. Ne ubukule ameno
kanje alemba obubi. Alaba
shiokhulia shianje khu tsinyanga
tsitaru.”

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Asitou yemba obulayi:
Sio mimi, sio mimi aliye na meno,
Mwenye meno bado yuko
nyumaaaaaah.
Joy yesi yemba olwimbo.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Olumalirisi, Sofia yemba.
Yali nende oburi olwa yachaka
okhwimba. Olwimbo lwali olubi
khandi amakhua shikali habwene
ta.
Unyalego yalokha, “Shonyala
okhwimba nga abashio tawe?”
Inzukha yamanya niye wali
nabukule ameno kaye
kang’inang’ina.

title: 0081_omutsuru-kwe-tsinzukha.md
text:
Unyalego yamira Sofia.
Abakhaana babo berukha okhutsia
mulukongo okhukanira be
mulukongo kali kekholeshe.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Khale, khwaliho nende omusiani walangungwa mbu Mukhwana.
Yali nende omukhaana wabu walangungwa mbu Mulongo.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Olwa mama nende papa wabu bafwa, batsia okhumenya nende
khotsa wabu. Ne balindwa obubi muno.
Bopungwa ne tsisala tsindambi, nende okhuyebwa obusera
obwangu bwangu okhunywa nge eshiakhulia lulala khunyanga.
Kho belukha nibakhama.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Banyoola libina nibamenyamo. Bali nende oburi okhubeera bali
nibaulila mbu amanani kali nikamenya mufikulu.
Kho bakasia omuliango kwamani okhufunikha obwinjililo, nende
emiluu chibili chiokhurera omuya nende obulafu.
Mukhwana yaboolela omukhaana wabu Mulongo, “Ikhalanga
mwibina olwa emba nendula elwanyi okhuyima, ne khandi
olatekha inyama tawe. Amanani kachama isami ye inyama
iteekhwa.”

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Buli ingolobe Mukhwana yachelelanga nende eshindu shia yali
niyerire-eshituyu nomba amayoni nomba eshichwaya.
Ne olwa yachelela mwibina, yemba:
“Mulongo, Mulongo, omwana wa mama, nzikulila libina. Tsipicho
tsinjile. Lili nemiluu chibili.”

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Mulongo yachoonya okhwikhala mwibina eshiteere shiosi. Kho
inyanga ndala olwa omusiani wabu yali niyakharula, yarula
elwanyi okhutsia okhwilolela eshialo. Nanyoola isebele
yokhubailamo, nende omusala kwokhunina. Yeulila nali
omulekhule khandi omusangafu.
“Aundi, napara, abalia-bandu babulao.” Aundi amanani kabulao
khotsa yenyanga busa okhukhurisia.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Inyanga yalondakho shiyali noburi bwosi bwosi tawe ne nabwana
omulilo okhwora. Ne yakubwana mwibina omuliango nikwikaleokhwikalila obusuku.
"Shimbara nobubi okhusambakho akhayama khatiti tawe. Nobulayi
okhubakho nende eshiakhulia eshiteshe."

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Omusiani wabu lwayacherera yemba shinga buli nyanga,
“Mulongo, Mulongo, omwana wa mama, nzikulira libina. Tsipicho
tsinyala okhwinjiramo, lili nende emiluu chibili.”
Yekula omuliango ne niyenjira.
Olwa yalola inyama indeshe, Mukhwana yareeba, “Okholire orie
obulali nende omuliro?
“Enjibakale khumubasu elwanyi we libina,” Mulongo nakalusia
bwangu bwangu.
Mukhwana yali nachonyere muno ne nalanyala okhuingana tawe,
nibekhala hasi nibatsililila okhulia.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Inyanga yalondakho Nakhwana nabwana omuliro khandi natekha
efiakhulia. Olwa yali niyakhamala busa omwoyo kwo khwimba
nikuulilikha elwanyi,
“Mulongo, Mulongo, Omwana wa mama, nzikulila omuliango kwe
libina lino. Tsipicho tsinyala okhwinjira. Lili nende emiluu chibili.”
Alali omwoyo oko shikwafwanana nende kwo musiani wabu tawe.
Nakhwana naboola ari, "Tawe ewe sholi omusiani wefu tawe;
omwoyo kwo shikufwanana nende okwaye tawe."
Yali nende obulindi obulayi mwibina.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Efise fititi nifiakhabura, omundu wundi yemba elwanyi welibina
khandi, “Nzikulila mwana wefu, Mulongo, Mulongo, omwana wa
mama, nzikulira libina. Tsipicho tsinyala okhwinjiramo. Lili nende
emiluu chibili.”
Omwoyo oko kwaulilikha shinga kwo musiani wabu, kho niyekula
omuliango.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Okundu okukhoongo kwa manywa khumubili kwosi kwetsula
obwinjililo bwe libina bwosi.
Kwayoya Mulongo nashili okhupara okhwilukha.
Mulongo yanyoola obwiyangu nayooya likoshe okhurula mumuliro.
Yalakasia likoshe khunjira ya balondakho ano nende alia olwa
yachingwa nibatsia.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Inyanga eyo, shia Mukhwana yanyalilwa okhukwakho mu khuima
khwe shiali omulinga kwe tsinzushi-yali nakusukune khwibeka.
Olwa yoola khwibina, yanyola omuliango kwe libina nikwikushe ne
omukhaana wabu natsile...ne likoshe nilinyululushe khunjira ilinjile
mumutsuru.
Yaloonda likoshe elo okhuula olwa yalola omulilo ehalekho.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Nikworanga omulilo oko kwaliho okundu okukhoongo okwa
amanywa khumubili kwosi nende omusiko omukhoongo hambi
nakwo. Mukhwana nachenda natsia wakwali, niyekatia
okhusiechela.
"Papa, nochama onyala okhukhonyakho? Embumiye eshilenje.
Ndenyakho amatsi."
Okundu oko nikumukalusia kuri, “Ndalakhuwa amatsi, nikaba mbu
ofuchirira mbu shiolatilakho khumusiko kwanje tawe."
Ne nikura omusiko kwako oko kaala obulayi mukhatsu khakwo.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Ne olwa kwatsia, Mukhwana nakhalaka olusia lwali niluboyele
omusiko oko, ne omukhana wabu naruuma narula mumusiko oko.
Mukhwana nashukhasia omusiko oko nende okukwe okwali
nikwitsulemo tsinzushi. Omukhana nomusiani wabu nibefisa
okhulola eshiali nishitsia okhwikholekha.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Olwa okundu oko kwetsa namatsi, omusiani nende omukhana
wakwo betsa ninako. Kwaboolera omukhana wako kuri,
"Eshindu eshilayi shili mumusiko munzu wefu. Tsia orere!!"
Omukhana oyo yatsia niyekulakho hatiti okhulola eshialimo.
Tsinzushi nitsimuluma omukhono, niyayula.
"Shilasanga.”
“Tsia omukhonye!” nikulanjilisia omusiani wako. Ne amakalusio kali
kalia kalia

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
“Olambukula ngo mundu omusiru tawe,” nikuyiibila omusiani
wako. Ne nikwikhupa munzu, nikubambula omusiko okwene.
Tsinzushi etsiali nende oburuma tsiapurukha ne tsirula elwanyi
nitsikuluma omurwe, eliulu nende tsimoni.
Ne olwa kwakhaywa okhulola, kwarumaruma nikuyochera nikuulila
obutsuni.

title: 0084_mukhwana-nende-mulongo.md
text:
Kwerukha nikukwira omurwe mwitiba, omurwe nekwiyabila
mumatoyi. Kwekalukhasia eshitsushi sho omusala eshiali
eshilayi okhuba omulinga kwe inzushi.
Efise efirambi inyuma wako, Mukhwana nende Mulongo balia
obushi obunulu okhurula mu mulinga oko.

text: Esomerekho wina? Enyala okhwisomera esie omwene.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Inyanga ndala inzala yakwa
mushialo. Abulao owali neshiokhulia
ilali amakhokho konyone.

Buli mu mabwibwi, kapurukhanga
nikatsia womusala kwa matunda
amengu kali amanulu. Kwali akari
womwalo omukhoongo.
Kakalukhanga nende amakhuyu
khulweshiakhulia shiako, nende
abekho bako.
Ifwana yamakhuyu yachiranga
omunwa kwa Anansi kwitsula amare
tu. Yapara shinga anyala
okhwinyolerakho yesi.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Yapara muno ne nanyoola
eshianyala okhukhola.
Yebakha khushitakho shiaye iula
bulaayi.
Yabukula inyungu yeliloba ne natsia
okhulola amakhokho.
“Munyala okhukhonyakho bayie?”
Yareeba.
“Ndenyakho amanda komuliro
okhubwanira omuliro kwanje'.
Ne olwa katsiririra okhutoola
amanda mumaika, Anansi yekhala
niyesisinia khu elala khu makhuyu
kali amakhongo, kho liande
khushibuno shie.
Yakalusiria amakhokho orio ingali,
ne narula elwanyi, nachenda
nabwao eshinyumanyuma okhula

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Kata kario, likhuyu elala lionyone
shiliakhamuyera tawe. Yakalukhayo
khandi olundi, nakhola ario.
Olwa yakalukhayo lwa khataru
khandi, amakhokho kachaka
okhumuparira eshia yali
niyenyanga.
“Eshichira nokalushiriranga hano
okhubukula omuliro ne shiina?”
kamureba.
Anansi nakakalusia ari, “Buli eshise
lwa ndula nango,
amanda kabetsa nikamalire
okhusima.”

“Obeyanga!”amakhokho
nikamubolera. "Wenyanga
efiakhulia fiefu!”
“Shikali kario tawe. Mukatia,"
nakabolera. Ne nachaka okhulira.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Mumabwibwi inyanga yalondakho,
buli likhokho liamwiyachila libaa, ne
napurukha nako okhutsia
khumukhuyu akari womwalo
omukhoongo.
Olwa yalola amakhuyu amengu
amanulu, Anansi yekomba koosi
kabe akaye.
Buli olwa likhokho liatema
okhufunakho likhuyu, yayula, “Elo
nelianje. Nesie ouranjirire
okhulilola". Mana nalifuna ne nalira
mumufuko kwe.

Okhumalilikha, yafuna amakhuyu
koosi ne amakhokho nikalanyoola
kho kata liosi tawe.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Yatong’a yenyene busa nga
eshirima shiachaka okhutiira.
“Nindalenya okhumenya khumusala
kuno obulamu bwanje bwosi,"
niyeparira, "ndalaruuma busa
mumuyeka shinga amakhokho.”
Kho yakhwesa emiuya mukari,
naruuma, ne....Tuumbu! nakwa
mumwalo akari we tsikwena.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
“Eshili ano nishi?” okwoyo
kweikwena nikurwarwakha.
"Shiakhaba eshindu eshinulu
shiokhulia, shiuu...”
Tawe nochama bayie!” Anansi
naboola. Ne niyaanza okhulira.
“Endi mulala khwinywe. Mukorirwe?
Ndakora mundalo tsia bakuka
benyu ne shiyalikhowo owanyala
okhunyoola tawe. Newe oweimberi
khubekho banje okhulolekha.”

Nalila muno muno okhuula tsikwena
nitsimulolera eshisa.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Ikwena ikhulundu yalikho,
shiyahuulila akeke ako tawe.
"Khulamanya noli mulala khwifwe
nikaba mbu onyala okhulia amatoyi
nende okhuulira obulayi shinga
efwe."
Nitsimwa eshisanda shia matsi
amabi amakhanyu.
“Kali nga aka kukhu yakasinjia!”
Anansi naboola.
Ne nakasia omuluu mwiloba nende
eshilenje shie inyuma, khandi
omuluu mushisanda nende
eshilenje shieimbeli. Olwa yekatia
okhunywa omunyu oko, kwatatsila
mumuluu oko mushisanda, asi
wefilenje fie.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
“Omunulu po!” niyekhomba
nakalusia yo eshisanda eshikhaya.
“Ahaa!” bulano khwakhamanya
mbu toto oli mulala khwifwe,"
tsikwena nitsiboola.
Bulano nitsielesia Mukatia
obwiyangu bwokhukona ninatsio
mubwina bwatsio.
“Mumabwibwi mutsuli,
ndalamuboolela olukano lwobulamu
bwanje,” Anansi natsiboolela olwe
tsindolo tsiabayila.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Mumabwibwi inyanga yalondakho,
eliuba nilishili okhufwinda, Anansi
nabuusia ndala khutsikwena itso.
“Abashio nibashiri mundolo, mbila
enyende omukhasi wanje nende
abaana banje injerekha womwalo,
betse bakhonye okhubabolela
olukano lwanje.”

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Ikwena yasinyikha nibubura khulwo
khubusibwa mundolo mumabwibwi.
"Nochama khonya. Ewe osokanga
bwangu okhushira esie," Anansi
naboola.
Ikwena niiyama. Anansi niyekhala
khumukongo kwe ikwena okhuula
khulukuku lwomwalo.
Yeekha bwangu bwangu, “Enjelela
busa bwangu bwangu ninde busa!”
Anansi naiboolela, ne
nakhamiushila mubunyasi.

title: 0094_anansi-amakhokho-nende-tsikwena.md
text:
Okhuula inyanga ino, Ikwena
ishilindanga khulukuku, namoolu
kayo nga amasingo khumatsi,
nende tsimoni tsiefipalapala
khumatsi ekulu.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Inyinga ndala, Eshituyu
shiali nishichendanga
khumwalo.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Ifubu yosi yali awo,
niichendanga ne
niyayanga obunyasi.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Ifubu siyali niimanyire
mbu Eshituyu shiosi
shiriwo tawe na
khulwokhukorwa,
niyitsukhanira niisenere
eshirenje shie Shituyu.
Eshituyu shiakhupa
oluungu nishianza
okhwayulila ifubu, “Ewe
Ifubu, sololanga mbu
usenanga eshirenje
shianje tawe?”

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Ifubu yasaba eshituyu
eshileshero, “Eshituyu,
ndeshera omwitsa
wanje.
Sembere nekhulutsi
tawe.
Nochama ndeshera.”
Eshituyu sishiaulira
tawe ne shiatsirira
okhupila ifubu oluungu,
“Usenere nende
lichomo.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Eshituyu shiatsia neshikhaba omuliro nishikubolela, “Tsia
osambe Ifubu niilarula erwanyi okhwaya. Lisenere.” Omuliro
nikumubolera, “Obubi bubulao Eshituyu omwitsa wanje.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Olundi ifubu yali
niyayanga ale nende
omwalo na
“Wuush!”Omuliro
kwarulira nikuchaka
okhusamba amoya ke
Ifubu.

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Ifubu yanza okhulira
niirushira mumwalo.
Obwoya bwayo bwosi
bwali nibuyiire.
Ifubi yatsiririra okhulira,
“Obwoya bwanje bwosi
buyirire mu muliro.
Osambire obwoya
bwanje bwosi.
Obwoya bwanje bwosi
butsire.
Obwoya bwanje bulayi.”

title: 0111_eshichira-ifubu-niibula-amoya.md
text:
Eshio ne shifune shichira ifubu sitsitsanga ale nende omwalo
tawe, khulwa oburi bwokhusambwa nende omuliro.
Eshimuna shiasangala sana olwa ifubu yayia nende omuliro,

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Emiaka chiabira, tsisolo
tsietsinzika tsiakhalaka liparo
okhuba nende obucheni
obukhongo ekulu mufikulu.
Balanga tsisolo tsindi
tsietsinzika tsionyone.
Omundu undi yesi yesi tawe.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Olwa ingurwe yaulira likhuwa
liobucheni ibo, yapara, "Embula
tsinzika. Endakhola shina?"

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Mustuli bushiere, yanyoola
inganakani.
Alahandia tsinzika khumurwe
kwaye okhurumushira iula.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Inganakani yayo yatiya ne
ingurwe ilola ili nende amachesi
lwayenjisibwa mubucheni.
Eshibi shiali mbu obucheni
bwali butsiririra hambi ne
eliuba.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Olwa obucheni bwetsulamwo
oluuya, iula yachaka
okhusalulukha na tsinzika tsiayo
tsikwa.
Tsisolo tsietsinzika tsiauka.
"Niwina oyo ubula tsinzika?
Yetsere shina hano?" bareeba.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Omwami we tsisolo yalokha,
"Khamare ingurwe muchifube
hasi khushialo." Bakhamara
ingurwe bachifuba hasi
khushialo.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Eshibera khungurwe! Olwa
yakwa, yakwira amolu kayo.
Eliulu liayo liapama khandi
listoba.

title: 0132_tsingurwe-shitsinjisibwa-tawe.md
text:
Kho olauka ta nolola eliulu
lieingurwe liapama khandi
okhutsoba, shichira liali lirio
okhurula khale.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Imbulu yanje ni nasie
khulenjeranga amayoni
mwikulu.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Amayoni kanje ninasi
khubukananga nende
inguche khumusala.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Inguche yanje ninasie
khubayanga nende
etsitika tsianje
khushikulu.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Etsitika tsianje ninasie
khukasinjia mipira
okhurula mwiloba.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Lishene lianje ni nasie
khulitsanga amaremwa
nende libungwe buli
nyanga.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Libungwe lianje nende
Lishene biaria Likhutu
mu tsinjira tsiosi.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Likhutu ni nasie
khutsitsanga ingo kala
kala nende Inzukha.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Inzukha ni nasie
khwayanza okhusaala
nende okhwimba
tsinyimbo khunyanza.

title: 0147_oluyia-lwanje-nende-esie.md
text:
Oluyia lwanje lwosi
nende esie khwamenya
halala mu busangafu!

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Mmutsuru kwa Elureko, lialio
lishene liali neshibeera khase.
Buli shise olwa lianyoolanga
omwana, yafwitsanga.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Obutsune bwokhufwisia abaana
baye bwachiranga lishene
liruma ekulu nende hasi.
Liarumanga okhurula khwisaka
elala okhutsia khulindi, nilirira,
"Kwi! Kwi! Kwi!"

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Lishene liali ne shibeera buli
shise.
Liali nende eshibeera muno
olwa lialola amashene kandi
nabaana babo.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Lishene lieshibeera liekhalanga
khulusaka lienga ekulu.
Tsinyanga tsiabira ne lishene
listiririra okhulira muno.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Liebula omwana khandi.
Liakhalaka liparo okhuira
omwana oyo khunjira kho
ababiri bamulole nokhumuha
tsikhabi.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Lishene liekha khulusaka nelira
omwana khunjira.
Mufise efio, omuyiimi yali
akalukha nango.
Yalola omwana we lishene
nakonere khuluchinga lwe injira.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Omuyiimi yachinga omwana wa
lishene nayiira nango uwe.
Olwa yatukha nango, abasiani
baye bataru benya okhuchinga
omwana wa lishene.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
text:
Abasiani bataru babaya
nibeemba:
"Khafube ekulu! Khafube hasi!"
"Khafube khu isie! Khafube khu
ulia!"
Omwana wa lishene yafubwa
okhurula khu mwana mulala
okhutsia khu undi.

title: 0154_lishene-nende-omukhaye-wo-muyiimi.md
