title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaan warra isaatifi obbolette isaa ishee waggan afuri walin jirata. lafa namaa soressa tokko gubbaa jiratan. Manii citaa isaani mukkenin marfamtee jiriti.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Yeroo umriin Sakiimaa waggaa sidi ta'e kufee iji isaa jaame. Sakiimaan mucaa jimaa ture.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaan hojii bayee warri wagga jahaa hihojjane hojata. Fakeenyaaf, maanggudootii ganda wajjiin taa'e dhimaa cimaa irrati nimari'ata.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Matiin Sakiimaa mana nama sorressaa kessa hojaatan. Isaanis ganamaan bahanii galgal galu. Sakiimaa obboleti isaa wajjiin manatti dhisanii deeman.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaan sirba sirbu jalata. Gaftokko harmeen isaa akkan jete isa gafatte. "Sakiimaa sirboota kana isaa barratee?"

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaanis debise, "Sirbonni akasuman dhufeu, harme. Sammuu kootin dhaggefadhen isaan sirba."

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaan obboletti isaatif sirbu jalata, kessaa yeroo isheen aarte. Obbolettin isaas nidhagefati. Isheen suta jette sirbitti.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: "Irra debitee nafsirbuu danadessa Sakiimaa" jete gafate obbolettin isaa.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Galgala tokko warri isaa gara manaa deebi'anii, cal jedhanii ta'an. Sakiimaan wanti tokko akka ta'ee nibeeka ture.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: "Maltu badee abba koo, harmee ko?" jedhe gaafate Sakiimaan. Sakiimaan mucaan nama soressa sani badee jira. Namitichis qophaa isaa wanta'ef aare ture.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaanis "Ani sirbuuf nandanada'a innis nigamada," jedhe warra isaati hime. Garuu warri isaa yadaa kana hinfudhanne, "Inni bayee soressa. Ati mucaa jamaa dha. Siribi kee waan isan gargaaru sittifakkataa?"

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Hata'uu malee, Sakiimaan shakkali isaa ittumma fufee. Obbolettin quxussun isaas isaa gargaarte. Akkam jette, "siribi Sakiimaa yeroon anigadee bayee nagaragar. Haluma kanan nama soressa kanas nigargaara."

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Guyyaa ittianu, Sakiimaan obbolettin isaa gara mana namtichaa soressa itti agarsiistu gafatee.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Foddaa guddaa tokko jala dhaabatee sirbuu calqaabe. Suuta jedhe mataan namtichaa soressa gara foddaati muldhatee.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Hojjatonni hojii isaani nidhaaban. Isaanis sirba bareeda Sakiimaa dhageefatan. Namtichi too akkan jedhe, "Namni tokko iyyu hoggana keynaa sabbarsisu hindanada'u. Mucaan jamaa kuni waandanda'u ittifakkataa?"

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Sakiimaan sirbaa siaa xummure jenaan deeme. Namitichi sooressi suni gadii bahee, "Mee irraa deebi'i sirbi adaraa."

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Yerooduma san namni lama nama wahi sireedhan bataani dhufan. Mucaan nama soressa sana rukkutame karaa gubbaa irratti gatamee argan.

title: 0315_sirba-sakiimaa.md
text: Namni soressi sun mucaan isaa agrachuu isaatin bayee gammadee. Sakiimman wan isaa sabbarsiseef badhaasa laatef. Sakiimaa fi mucaa issaa gara mana yaalla gessee.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Bakki dhabbata atobusaa xinnan ganda kenyaa namafi konkolatootan dhiphatee jira. Kanarra hafee wanti fe'amu qabu bayee tu lafa jira. Namooni tikeeti gurguran konkolatoota iyyan.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: "Magaala! Magaala! Gare dhihaa!" jedhe gargaran konkolachisa. Konkolaatan suni kana ani barbaadu ture.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Atobisiin magaaladha bayee guutee jiraa namni garu yabbachuuf ifaaja. Namonni tokko tokko meshaa isaani konkolaata jalatti fe'atan. Namonni kuni immo kessa kayaatan.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Imaltooni harenyi tiikeetiissani cimsani qabatanii lafa teesuma barbadatan. Dubartoonii da'imaa qabana imala isaanif mijeesan.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Ani immo dubarti abban mana irradu'ee tokko biran taa'e. Namni nabira taa'e tokko immo borsaa lasticaa hammatee qabateera. Qophee dulomaafi and kootii dulooma uffate waan aare fakkaata.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Fodddaa konkolatatiin gara alaa yeroon qayee koo ittiguddadhe dhisee gara magaala deemuu koon qayyabadhe. Gara magaala gudda deeman jira.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Meshaa fe'un xummurame jennan namni hunduu tesso qabatee taa'e. Daldaaltonni karaa gubbaa meshaa isaani gurguruf gara keessati lixan. Namni hunduu waan bituu barbaade gafachaa ture. Wacini sun garuu nadinqisisee.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Namooni tokko tokko yeroo wandhugamu bitatan kuuni immo waandhugan bitatan. Namonni akka anaa kan mallaqaa hinqabne, cal jedhanituma ilaalan.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Sochiin suni garu kalaksii konkolaatatin addan citee. Gargaaran konkolaachisaa daldaltootan bu'aa jedhe itti iyyee.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Daldaltonni dafan waldhibanii bahan. Tokko tokko deebi namootaf kenan. Kuuni immo daqiqaa isaa dhumaatitis gurguirf yalaan.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Akkuma atobisin bakka dhaabbate ka'ee, gara foddatin allatin ilaale. Akkam godheen gara gandaa kiyyaa deebi'aa jdheen yaadee ture.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Akkuma imalli ittifufen, konkolaata kessa bayee o'ee. Ejjaa koo cuffen rafuu barbaade.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Samuu koo garu gara maana yaada. Harmeen koo nangan turtii moo? Hiiletiin kiyya gatii baftui ta'a? Obbolessi koo iyyiba sana yadatee bishan obaasa laata?

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Osoon deema jiru lafa essumini koo jiru magaala sana kessati yaadadhee. Hiribaa kessatin kufatin deeema.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Sa'ati sagal booda, sagalee cimaa gara ganda kessani deebi'a jedhu dhagahe. Borsaa koo qabbadheen konkolaata kessa utalee bahe.

title: 0324_guyyan-gara-magaala-deeme.md
text: Konkolaatan gara ganda deebi'u dafee gutee. Dafee garaa bahaa qajelee. Rakkinnii cimaan kiyyaa akkam godheen mana essuma kiyya akkan itti argadhu yaadu ture.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Arbi tokko bishan dhuguu deema.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Sattawwan lama bishan dhuguu deeman.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Gafarasa sadi fi simbroni afur bishan dhuguuf deeman.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Kurupheen shanifi boyyyeen jaha gara lagaa deemu.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Haree didoon torba gara bishanii figuu.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Raachi saddetifi qurxuumin sagal bishaan daaku.

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Leenci tokko nibookisa. Innis bishan dhuggu barbaade. Enyuutu leenca sodaata?

title: 0327_beladoota-lakau.md
text: Arbi tokko leencichaa waliin bishaan dhuga.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Yeroo took matii gammachudhan jiratu tokkotu ture.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Wal-lolani hinbekan. Matii isaani manatis ta'e allati nigargaaru.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Garuu gara ibbiddati siquu dhorgamani turan.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Hojii isaani halkan hojachuu qaban. Sababin isaas matiin kuni gagaa irra hojataman!

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Isaan kessaa mucaan tokko garu gara adduti bahuu fedhee ture.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Kessaahu gaftokko bayee hawee garu obbolawan isaa isa dhorgan.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Dhorgam suni bayee ture. Muccichi addu kessati baqee jira.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Ijooleen gaga yeroo obbolessi isani baqu argudhan bayee aaran.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Sagantaa qaban turan. Gagaa baqee sana gara simbrooti gedaran.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Obbolessa isaani simbirro kan gara gaara guddaa gessan.

title: 0337_ijoolee-gagaa.md
text: Akkuma addun bateen sirbaa balali'aa deeman.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Gaftokko mamman fuduraa bayee argate.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: "Fuduraa yeroo kama nyaachu dandenyaa?" Jenne gafanne. "Fuduraa galgal kana nyanna," jette harmeen.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Obbolessi ko Rahiim sassatadha. Fuduraa hundaa dhamdhameera. Bayee nyaates.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: "Waan Rahiim godhe ilaali!" jedhe obbolessi koo xinnan. "Rahiim sassatuf kaka'aa dha," jedhe.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Harmeen bayee Rahiimit aarte.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Nutis bayee Rahiimiti aare. Rahiim garu humma iyyu ittihinfakkanne.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: "Rahiim hinadabddu jeechudah?" jedhe obbolessi koo xinnaan.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: "Rahiim amma kana nigadita," jetten harmeen.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Rahiima dhukkubu calqabe.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: "Garaa koo nadhukubee," jedhe Rahiim.

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Harmeen akka kuni ta'u nibeekit turte, Fuduraan Rahiim adabaa jira!

title: 0342_adabbi.md
text: Boodee, Rahiim dhifamaa nugaafate. "Ani lammata sassatu hinta'u," jedhe waada gale. Nuhundi keenyaa isa amanne.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Yaanbadiisa waxay ahayd mid aad u gaaban.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Albaabkiisa waxuu ahaa mid aad u hooseeyo.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Sariirtiisa waxay ahayd mid aad u gaaban.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Baaskiilkiisa waxuu ahaa mid aad u gaaban.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Ninkan aad ayuu u dheeraa!

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Waxuu sameeyay daab yaanbo aad u dheer.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md
text: Waxuu sameeyay gidaaro albaab oo aad u sareeyo.

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md

title: 0001_nin-aad-u-dheer.md

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Alisha waxay u baahan tahay inay shaqo hesho, waayo qoyskeedu waxay u baahan yihiin lacag ay ku iibsadaan cunto iyo dhar.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Alisha kamaysoo shaqaynin waddankeedii, laakiin waxay ku fiicanayd cunto karinta, waxayna jeceshahay inay dadka la sheekaysato.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Laga yaabaa inay ka shaqayn karto makhaayad? Alisha waxay interneedka ka raadisaa shaqooyinka lasoo dhigo.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Waxay heshay xayeysiis loogu talagalay cunto kariye. Taas oo ah qof makhaayad wax ku karinaya.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Waxay aadaa waraysiga shaqada. Maamulaha makhaayadda ayaa u sheegay inay u baahan yihiin qof u tababartay cunto karinta.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Alisha waa ay niyad jabtay, laakiin waxay qaadatay koorso loo yaqaan "koorsada “Cuntada karinta iyo soo dhawaynta". Waxayna rajaynaysaa in tani ay ka caawin doonto inay shaqo ka hesho makhaayad.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Alisha waa in ay ka shaqayso makhaayad taas oo qayb ka ah koorsadeeda tababarka. Mushaar ma hesho, balse waxay helaysaa khibrad shaqo.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Waxay ku dartay faahfaahinta koorsada CV-geeda. CV-gu waa sharaxaad ku saabsan dhammaan shaqooyinkii ay soo qabatay iyo dhammaan koorsooyinkii ay soo qaadatay.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Marka xigta ee ay Alisha aaddo wareysi shaqo oo makhaayad ah, waxaa loo soo bandhigay shaqada. Waa shaqo adag. Inta badan waa in ay shaqeyso fiidkii, marka carruurteeda ay ka yimaadaan iskoolka.

title: 0001_shaqo-raadin.md
text: Waa ay ku faanaysaa in ay shaqo heshay si ay cunto iyo dhar qoyskeeda ugu soo iibiso lacagteeda.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Ri, eey iyo sac baa waxay a haayeen saaxiibo isku wayn. Maalin maalmaha kamid ah waxay aadeen safar waxayna raaceen taksi.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Markay gaadheen dhammaadkii safarkooda, darawalka ayaa weyiiyay in ey bixiyaan nooligooda. Sici waxuu bixiyay lacagtiisi.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Eeygi waxuu bixiyay xoogaa dheerad ah, sababtoo ah ma uusan haysan lacag sax ah.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Darawalka waxuu siin rabay eeyga baaqigiisa markay rida carartay ayadoon waxbo bixinin.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Darawalka aad buu u xanaaqay. Garrigii buu waday asagoo siinin eeygi baaqigiisi.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Taasina waa sababta xitaa maanta, eeyga uu ugu ordo gaadhiga si uu u qooraansado oo u helo darawalkii ka qabay baaqiga.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Rida waxa ay ka carartaa baabuurka xiinkiisa. Waxay kacabsi qabtaa in loo xidho bixin la aanta nooligi.

title: 0004_ri-eey-iyo-sac.md
text: Saca na dan kamalahan markuu baabuur soo socdo. Saca waxuu qaataa waqtigiisa si uu jidka u gudbo sababtoo ah waxuu og yahay in uu bixiyay nooligiisi si dhameystiran.

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Waagii hore dadku waxba ma aysan aqoon. Ma aynan aqoon sida miro loo beero ama sida dhar loo sameeyo ama sida bir qalab looga sameeyo. Illaaha cirka kore ee Nyame ayaa lahaa xikmadi aduunka oo idil. Waxa uu na ku kaydiyey dhari dhoobo ah.

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Nyame waxuu goansaday in uu dhariga xikmada ah siiyo Anansi. Mar walba oo uu Anansi eego gudaha dhariga dhoobada ah, waxuu bartaa wax cusub. Waxa ayna ahayd arin aad u xiiso badan!

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Damaaci Anansi waxuu ku fikiray "waa in aan ku xafidaa dhariga dusha geed dheer. Si aan dhamaan kaligay u heysto!" Waxa uu soohay xarig dheer, dharigii dhoobada ayuu ku wareejiyay, dhexda ayuuna ku sii xirtay. Waxuu bilaabay in uu geedka fuulo. Lakin aad ayay ugu adkayd fuulida geedka ayadoo dhariga ka garaacayay jilbaha mar walba.

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Intaa oo dhan Anansi wiilkiisi yaraa ayaa taagnaa geedka hoostiisa oo daawanayay. Waxuu yiri, "Miyaysan sahlanaan laheyn in aad fuusho hadii aad dhariga dhabarka ku xirato?" Anansi waxa uu isku dayay ku xirashada dharigii dhoobada ahaa oo ay xikmadu ka buuxday dhabarkiisa, waxayna dhab ahaanti aheyd mid in badan fudud.

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Waqti yar ba waxuu gaaray geedka dushiisa. Laakiin markiiba wuu istaagay waxa uu na ka fikiray, "Aniga uun bay ahayd midka heysto xikmad oo dhan, hadana meeshan wiilkayga ayaa iga xariifsan aniga!" Anansi aad buu u carooday dharigii dhoobada ayuu geedka kasoo tuuray.

title: 0006_anansi-iyo-xikmad.md
text: Dhulka ayuuna jajab ugu burburay. Xikmaddii way xorowday si qof waliba qayb uga helo. Waana sababta ay hadda dadku u barteen sid loo beerto, sida dhar loo tosho, qalab looga sameysto birta, iyo wax walba oo kale oo dadku ay hada yaqaanaan sida loo sameeyo.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Magacaygu waa Malik, oo waxaan ahay 39 jir. Waxaanna ku dhashay Afghanistan. Diintaydu way ka duwan tahay diinta ugu weyn ee Afghanistan.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Sannado badan, dadka diintayda haysta waa la silciyey. Tani aad bay ugu adkayd qoyskayga.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Dhowr sanno ka hor waxaa dhacay dagaal. Waxaanna ka baqay in la i dilo. Waxaan ka soo tagay qoyskeyga si aan u aado Yurub oo aan u bilaabo nolol cusub.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Waxaan u soo lugeeyay kilomitiro badan. Mararka qaarkood cunto ma haysan iyo meel aan dego. Qaar ka mid ah dadkii aan la soo safray way dhinteen.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Ugu dambayntii waan imid. Waxaan la kulmay dad ka yimid waddankeyga oo i caawiyay. Ma garanayo waxa aan samayn lahaa la'aantood.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Waxaan bilaabay inaan luuqadda barto, laakiin way igu adkayd. Waxaan ogaa in ku hadalka luqadda ay muhiim u tahay in la helo shaqo.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Waxaan baranaayey dhowr sanno, markii ugu horeysay si aan u barto luqadda. Way adkeed, laakiin waxaan ka helaa barashada waxyaabaha cusub.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Waxbarashada ka dib waxaan bilaabay shaqo. Markii hore waxaan ka shaqeeyay makhaayad, ka dibna waxaan noqday macalin sababtoo ah waxaan rabaa inaan caawiyo dadka kale.

title: 0014_sheekada-malik.md
text: Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan maalin ku laabto Afghanistan. Dad badan oo halkaas jooga ayaa u baahan caawimo, waxaana rabaa inaan caawiyo.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Magacaygu waa Agostino, waxaan ahay 51 jir. Shaqadaydu waa in aan cuntada ku geeyo baaskiil. Waxaan leeyahay laba gabdhood, laakiin badanaa ma wada hadalno. Sababtoo ah Aniga iyo hooyadood hadda ma wada noolin oo waanu kala tagnay.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Waxaan la noolahay hooyaday, maadaama aanan awoodin inaan bixiyo kirada furiinka ka dib. Kiradu aad bay qaali ugu tahay magaaladan.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Dhawr bilood ka hor waxaan ka shaqaynaayey goob shirkad ah sidii shaqaale waardiye ah. Waxaan dib u hagaajiyay waxyaalihii jabay, waxaan u qaadaayey sanduuqyo, oo caawinayay marka qof kastaa u baahdo caawinaad. Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah shirkadii ayaa shaqada iga eriday. Maan fahmin sababta.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Waxaan arkay dad badan oo cunto ku keenaya baaskiil. Anna waan kaxayn karaa baaskiilka, marka waxaan garaacay albaabka shirkad weyn oo alaabaha qaada. Waxay ii soo bandhigeen saddex Euro oo halkii mar ee alaab gayn ah. Waxaan sameeyaa 40 € maalintii, 60 € haddii aan aad u nasiib badanahay oo macaamiishu igu tilmaamaan.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Ma helo fasaxa wax lacag ah, ma jiro mushahar markaan xanuunsado, wax xuquuq ah oo dhan ma haysto. Uma maleynayo inay taasi sax tahay, balse waxaan u baahanahay shaqada. Inta badan shaqaalaha kale waa muhaajiriin ka kala yimid adduunka oo dhan.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Kadib, markii nin 25 jir ah oo gaarsiiye ahaa uu gaadhi ku dhuftay oo uu dhintay. Maamulka ayaa bilaabay inay na ogaadaan markaa. Waase ceeb inay na ogaadaan marka uu dhintay, waxay ahayd ka hor inta aanay dhicin.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Si wada jir ah oo ay weheliyaan dad kale oo gaarsiiyayaal ah oo ka socda shirkado kale, waxaan koorso ku saabsan xuquuqda shaqaalaha ka qaatay urur maxalli ah. Waxay noo soo bandhigeen la talin sharci oo bilaash ah. Waxaannu u halgamnay sidii aan aqoonsi iyo xuquuq badan u heli lahayn.

title: 0015_sheekada-agostino.md
text: Wakhti dheer kadib dedaalkayagii oo dhan waa noo hirgalay. Mid ka mid ah shirkadaha waaweyn ee keenista alaabada ayaa ku qasbanaaday inay bixiso ganaax aad u weyn oo ay siiso shaqaalaha shaqooyin joogto ah. Waxay ahayd markii ugu horeysay ee ay ka dhacda meel kasta oo adduunka ah. Waxay u egtahay in arrimuhu ay bilaabmeen inay horumaraan.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Selamawit waa 29 jir. Ilmaheedii ugu horreeyay ayay ku dhashay dalka Eritrea. Ayada iyo qoyskeeda ayaa halkaas waqti adag kala kulmay, markaas ayay go’aansadeen inay Talyaaniga aadaan.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Inga waxay ka tagtay guriga wax yar ka hor in taanay gaarin 19 jir. Waxay u guurtay Norway waxayna halkaas ku dhashay cunuggeedii ugu horreeyay.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Markii Selamawit ay uur yeelatay ilmaheedii labaad, waxay la yaabtay sida ay noqon doonto haddii ay ilmo waddan kale ku dhasho.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Selamawit iyo Inga waxay ka yimaadeen meelo kala duwan. Selamawit waxay dareentay badbaado sababtoo ah waxay khibrad u lahayd ummusha. Inga waxay hooyadeed kala hadashay arrimaha dhalmada.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Labada haweenba waxay maqleen in, inta badan dalalka Yurub, haweenka uurka leh ay xaq u leeyihiin daryeelka dhalmada ka hor. Taas macnaheedu waa in ay heli doonaan caawimo inta ay uurka leeyihiin. Selamawit waxay ballan la yeelatay dhakhtarkeeda isla markii ay xaqiiqsatay inay uur leedahay. Selamawit ninkeedii ayaa u kaxeeyay dhakhtarka.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Dhaqtarku wuxuu sameeyay xoogaa baaritaanno ah wuxuuna ogaaday in Selamawit ay qabto nooc ka mid ah cudurka sokorta oo haweenka uurka leh qaarkood ay qaadaan. Waxay ahayd inay cunto cunto caafimaad leh iyo inay jimicsi samayso. Selamawit way ku faraxday inay goor hore u tagtay dhakhtarka, ka hor intaanay iyada iyo ilmaheeda xanuunsan.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Markii deriska Inga uu maqlay inay isku dayeyso inay ilmo dhasho, deriska ayaa u sheegay inay u tagto dhakhtar isla marka ay uur yeelato. Sidaas ayay ku hubin kartaa inay caafimaad qabaan iyada iyo ilmaheeda. Dhakhtarka ayaa u sheegay inay qaadato kiniinka Folic acid oo ah fitamiin muhiim u ah haweenka uurka leh.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Inga iyo dhakhtarkeedu waxay ku heshiiyeen inay la kulanto ummuliso si ay u hesho baaritaan joogto ah inta ay uurka leedahay. Ummulisada ayaa siisay talooyin ku saabsan cuntada iyo nasashada, iyo macluumaadka ku saabsan sidii ay nafteeda iyo ilmaheedaba u ilaalin lahayd una badbaadin lahayd.

title: 0016_dhalmada.md
text: Labada haweenba waxay dhaleen ilmo caafimaad qaba. Selamawit waxay dhashay wiil kale, halka Inga ee leedahay gabadh. Nimankooduna aad bay ugu faanayaan, oo qof kasta oo ay garanayeen ayay u sheegi jireen xaasaskooda xoogga badan iyo carruurtooda caafimaadka qaba.

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: Tom iliga ayaa xanuunaya. Iligkiisu aad buu u xanuunayaa.

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: Wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu arko dhakhtarka ilkaha, laakiin marka hore wuxuu u baahan yahay daawo xanuun baabi’iye ah.

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: Wuxuu u socdaa farmaysiga ugu dhow.

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Iliga ayaa ixanuunaya," ayuu yidhi. "Wax ma u haysaan taas?"

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Haa, waa kuwan qaar ka mid ah xanuun baabi'iyaha. Uma baahnid warqad dhakhtar kuu qoray."

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Mahadsanid, imisa ayay isku noqonayaan?"

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Waxay isku noqonayaan sagaal euro, laakiin waa inaad aragto dhakhtarka ilkaha."

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Hagaag, waxaan wici doonaa dhakhtarkayga ilkaha berri subax."

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Haddii aad u baahan tahay daawo ka xoog badan, waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad ka hesho warqad dhakhtar ilkeed ama dhakhtarkaaga."

title: 0017_qaadashada-daawada.md
text: "Mahadsanid! Nabadgelyo."

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md
text: Shaadhka Ali waa uu dhamaaday. Mid cusub ayuu u baahan yahay.

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md
text: Wuxuu aadaya suuqa laga dukaameysto si uu dhar cusub u raadiyo.

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md

title: 0021_gadashada-dharka.md
text: Ali wuu galay dukaanka kadibna shaadh ka raadsaday. Shaadhadhku aad bay ugu weyn yihiin isaga, aadna ayey qaali u yihiin.

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: Tulima waxay jeceshahay muusigada. Maalin walba way dhegaysataa.

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: Saaxiibadeed Carlos iyo Anita sidoo kale waxay ka helaan muusigga.

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: "Tulima, muusig noocee ah ayaad ka heshaa?" ayuu Carlos weydiiyey.

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: "Waan ka helaa muusigga reer galbeedka, laakiin waxaan ka door bidaa muusigada dalkayga Itoobiya."

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: "Waxaan ka imid Kolombiya, kaliya waxaan dhagaystaa salsa. Waxay ku wanaagsan tahay dheesha," ayuu yidhi Carlos.

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: Anita ayaa tiri, "Waxaan ka helaa heesaha jaceylka ah iyo muusigyada iga farxiya."

title: 0024_muusiga-noocee-ah-ayaad-ka-heshaa.md
text: Muusiga noocee ah ayaad ka heshaa?

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Qoys ma leedahay?"

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Haa, aniga iyo ninkayga waxaan leenahay laba gabdhood iyo wiil."

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Waxaan sidoo kale leeyahay laba gabdhood, laakiin waa la i furay."

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Immisa sano ayay jiraan gabdhahaaga?"

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Mina waa afar jir, waxay aadaa iskoolka barbaarinta, Miriam waa toban jir, marka waxay aadaa iskoolka."

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Dhammaan carruurteyda waxay dhigtaan iskoolka, wiilkaygu wuxuu qalin jabin doonaa sanadka soo socda."

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Taasi waa wax weyn! Waxay u koreen si degdeg ah. Muxuu rabaa inuu sameeyo ka dib?"

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Wuxuu rabaa inuu shaqo helo, laakiin waxaan u sheegaa inuu jaamacad galo."

title: 0025_ka-hadalka-qoyska.md
text: "Taasi waa fikrad wanaagsan, waxaan sidoo kale rajeynayaa in carruurteyda ay jaamacad geli doonaan isku maalin."

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Maalmuhu waxay ku bilaabmayaan inay qaboow noqdaan. Waa maxay heerkulka?"

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Waa sagaal digrii, weli waa dayrtii, laakiin dhawaan waxay noqon doontaa jiilaal."

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Waxaan sugi la'ahay guga, laakiin waxaan doorbidaa xagaaga, markay fiicantahay oo diirantahay."

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Waxba kama qabo qabowga, laakin ma jecli roobka iyo dabaysha."

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Bal eeg daruurahaas gudcurka ah, berito roob baa da'aya, oo weliba dabaylo badan baa iman doona. Waxaa laga yabaa inuu iman doono duufaan."

title: 0026_ka-hadalka-cimilada.md
text: "Ma filayo inay dhacdo. Runtii ma jecli cimilada xun, gaar ahaan guga iyo hillaaca. Waxaan ka baqayaa in hillaacu inuu igu dhaco."

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Tuuladayda waxay lahayd dhibaatooyin badan. Waxaan samaynay saf dheer si aan biyo ooga soo dhaansano tuubada.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Waxaan sugnay raashin ay nagu deeqeen dad kale.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Waxaan xirnay guryahanaga amin hore sababta oo ah tuugo.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Caruur badan ayaa dugsiga ka baxday.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Gabdhaha yaryar waxay ka shaqeeyeen sidii adeegto tuulooyinka kale.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Wiilasha yaryar waxay ku wareegeysteen agagaarka tuulada halka kuwa kale na ay ka shaqeeyeen beeraha dadka.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Markii dabayshu kacdo, waraaqaha qashinka ayaa ka lalmado geedaha iyo dayrarka.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Dadka waxaa jarjaray dhalooyin jajaban kuwaa oo loo tuuray si taxadar la'aan ah.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Kadib hal maalin, tuubada ayaa biyo la'aan laga dhigay weelashanadana faaruq bey ahaayeen.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Aabahay ayaa guri guri ugu tagay asagoo waydiinayo dadka in ay ka qayb galaan shirka tuulada.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Dadka waxay iskugu soo urureen geed wayna hoostiisa wayna dhagaysteen.

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Aabahay ayaa istaagay waxuuna yidhi, "Waxaan u baahanahay in aan wada shaqayno si aan u xallino dhibaatooyinkeena."

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Juma oo sideed jir ah, oo kufadhiyo jirridda geedka ayaa ku qeyliyay, "Waan kaa caawin karaa nadiifinta."

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Haweeney ayaa tiri, "Dumarka way igu soo biiri karaan si ay u beeraan cuntada."

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Ninkale ayaa istaagay oo na yidhi, "Raggu waxa ay qodi doonaan ceel."

title: 0027_goaan.md
text: Dhammaanteen waxaan ku dhawaaqnay, "Waan ku qasbanahay in aan badelno nolosheena." Maalintaas laga bilaabo waxaan ka wada shaqeynay inaan xallino dhibaatooyinkeena.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Edson waxa uu ku dhashay Angola, wax yar uun ka dib markii uu dalkoodu xornimada qaatay. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aad u dheer. Dhererkiisa awgeed ayuu kuwa kale kaga duwanaa. Dadkii hubka siin jiray carruurta si ay ugu dagaalamaan askar ahaan dagaaladii sokeeye waxay doonayeen wiilal isagoo kale ah.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Hooyadii waxay ka cabsatay inay kaxaystaan, markaas ayay go'aansatay inay u dirto inuu kula noolaado habaryartii Portugal. Waxay u malaynaysay inuu halkaas ku nabadgeli doono.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Aad bay u adkeyd bilaawgii horre, maadaama Edson uu u xiisay cimilada diiran, cunta dhaqameedka iyo ugu badnaan, laabta gelintii iyo dhunkashada hooyadiis.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Si fiican ugumuu hadli karin luuqada Boortaqiiska, aad ayeyna ugu adkeyd inuu la socdo fasaladiisa iyo la sheekeysiga saaxiibadiis. Waxa uu iswaydiin jiray in ay tahay fikrad wanaagsan in uu yimaado Portugal.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah macalin ayaa ogaaday sida uu ugu fiican yahay kubbadda gacanta. Waxa uu ku biiray koox kubadda gacanta ah oo uu aad ugu guulaystay. Waxa uu caan ka noqday iskoolka oo uu yeeshay saaxiibo. Wuxuu kaloo noqday qof kalsooni badan.

title: 0027_ka-duwanaanshaha-sababta-saxda-ah.md
text: Hadda oo uu qaan-gaaray, Edson wuxuu tababaraa carruurta qaxootiga ah iyo kuwa kale ee laga takooro bulshada. Mar, dhererkiisu waxa uu halis galiyay in uu carruurta la askaraynayo noqdo. Hadda, dhererkiisu wuxuu siinayaa awood uu dadka kale ku caawiyo inay dareemaan ammaan.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Yulia, ninkeeda iyo gabadhooda yar waxay ku noolaayeen tuulo yar oo xasilloon oo ku taal Ukraine. Yulia waxay aad u jeclayd in subax walba kusoo kacdo dhawaaqa shimbiraha. Marna uma malaynayn inay guri ka fog degi doonto, ama aanay ku toosi doonin dhawaqa shimbiraha subaxdii.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Ninkeeda ayaa had iyo jeer ka caban jiray in aanu lacag ku filan haysanin, wuxuuna bilaabay inuu si aad ah u cabbo khamriga. Waxay go'aansadeen inay nasiibkooda ku tijaabiyaan Portugal. Waxaa laga yaabaa in ay halkaas ka heli karaan lacag badan si ay guri u dhistaan oo ay mustaqbal wanaagsan ugu sameeyaan qoyskooda.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Yulia waxay si fiican ula qabsatay gurigeeda cusub, waxayna bilowday inay ka shaqeyso sidii nadiifiye. Macaamiisheeda ayaa runtii aad uga mahadceliyey dadaalkeeda iyo hab-dhaqankeeda wanaagsan. Dhanka kale ninkeeda waxa uu dareemay in laga tagayo. Dhibaatada khamriga awgeed, loo-shaqeeyayaashu ma aaminaan isaga mana siin doonaan shaqo.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah ayuu bilaabay inuu ku qayliyo Yulia. Dabadeed, wuxuu bilaabay inuu riixo. Qayladii iyo garaacii baa ka sii daray, siiba markuu sakhraansanaa. Yulia waxay u baqday nafteeda iyo gabadheeda, laakiin ma aysan garanayn waxay samayn karto.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Markii Yulia ugu dambeyntii ay tagtay qolka gargaarka degdegga ah ee cusbitaalka iyada oo gacan ka jaban, waxay u sheegeen in rabshadaha qoysku ay dhibaato weyn ku tahay Portugal. Waxa kale oo ay sheegeen in arrintaasi ay tahay dambi, isla markaana ay tahay inay Booliska wargeliso.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Yulia waa ay ku daashay oo ma aysan dooneyn in gabadheeda yar ay ku korto guri ay maalin kasta goobjoog u ahayd rabshad. Yulia waxay ogaatay in calaamadaha xadgudubka ay horay u jireen, xitaa haddii ay qaadatay qaabab badan oo kala duwan.

title: 0028_codka-shimbiraha-subaxdii.md
text: Yulia waxay tagtay hoyga haweenka, halkaas oo ay dareentay in ay ka heshay ammaan ka badan intii ay haysatay muddo dheer. Taasi may dareemin tan iyo markii ay subaxdii ku toosi jirtay codka shimbiraha.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Aniga iyo labadayda walaalo waxaan nimid Norway December 2016. Waxaan xirnayn dharka xagaaga, sababtoo ah waxaan u maleynaynay inay kulushahay Norway sida Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, markii aan nimid garoonka diyaaradaha, waxaa jiray baraf. Waxaana jiray qabow, cimiladuna waa ay qaboobaayd. In kasta oo aannu dhawr boorsooyin wadanay, haddana waxaan wadanay oo keliya dharka xagaaga.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Inkasta oo ay qabow ahayd, aad ayaan ugu farxay markaan Norway nimid. Waxaan ugu dambeyntii la kulmi lahaa hooyaday markale, oo aanan arag muddo lix sano ah. Hooyaday iyo laba saaxiibadeheed ayaa nala kulmay. Markaan aragnay iyadii ayaannu farxad la ooynay. Waxaan u sii raacnay magaalada yar ee ay hooyo ku nooshahay.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Maalmihii ugu horreeyay ee magaalada hooyo degantahay waxay ahaayeen kuwo la yaab leh. Qabow iyo baraf baa da’ay oo wax badan ma jirin. Waddooyinka ayaa gabi ahaanba faaruq ahaa. Dadka yar ee aan la kulmay waxay u muuqdeen kuwo aamusan oo aan wax saaxiibtinimo lahayn. Soomaaliya waxaa jiray dad meel walba jooga, sidaa darteed wax walba waxa ay dareemayeen si nooc kale ah halkan. Hooyaday iyo saaxiibadeed waxay na siiyeen xoogaa hadiyado ah, ka dibna waxay noo kaxaysay suuqa si aan u soo iibsanno dharka qabowga.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Kadib fasaxa Kirismaska waxaan ku biiray koorsada Norwejiga ee xarunta waxbarashada dadka waaweyn. Waxaan halkaas ku bartay laba sano ka hor intaanan bilaabin iskool caadi ah. Hadda waxaan ku jiraa sannadkii ugu dambeeyay, waxaanan yeeshay saaxiibo badan oo cusub. Waxaan ahay qof bulshaawi ah oo waxaan ka helaa la kulanka dadka kale.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Iskoolka ka dib waxaan aadaa xarun ay maamulaan dad iskaa wax u qabso ah halkaas oo aan ka helo caawinta shaqada gurigayga. Waxaan sidoo kale ku biiray koorsada harqaanka ee xarunta.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Soomaaliya waligey iskool ma dhigan mana dhigan koorso aan ka ahayn dugsi quraan. Ma aqoonin sida wax loo akhriyo ama loo qoro. Hadda waxaan bartay sida loo qoro af-soomaali iyo af-noorwiiji, iyo maadooyin kale oo badan. Waxbarasho la'aanteed waxaan dareemay inaan qofna ahayn. Hadda waxaan dareemayaa inaan ahay qof aqoon iyo farxad leh.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Sannadka soo socda waxaan bilaabi doonaa iskoolka sare ee qaybta caafimaadka iyo horumarinta dhalinyarada. Mustaqbalka waxaan rabaa inaan noqdo shaqaale dhalinyaro ah. Markaan dhammeeyo waxbarashada, riyadeydu waa inaan helo shaqo joogto ah. Waxa kale oo aan rabaa in aan barto darawalnimada oo aan helo shatiga darawalnimada.

title: 0029_imaanshaha-norway.md
text: Haddaan Soomaaliya joogi lahaa, waxaan filayaa inaan hadda hooyo ahaan lahaa. Laga yaabaa in aan hore u yeelan lahaa carruur badan. Haddii aan Soomaaliya joogi lahaa, ma helin fursadaha aan hadda haysto. Waxaan dareemayaa inaan nasiib leeyahay in aan ku noolaado Norway.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Waxaan u maleeynaye in ragga Norwiijiga ay yihiin ragga ugu fiican adduunka, balse taasi run maaha! Kahor intaanan la kulmin ninka noqday ninkayga, waxaan ka shaqeeynaye Warshad ku taal Bangkok, wuxuu ku noolaa Pattaya. Waxaan ku kulanay internetka oo aan ugu dambeyntii noqonnay lamaane.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Muddo ka dib waxa aanu go’aansanay in aannu is guursano. Waxaan ka soo jeedaa qoys sabool ah, markaa in aan haysto nin ajnabi ah oo daryeeli kara qoyskayga waxay qayb ka ahayd sababta aan u guursaday.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Waxaan u soo guurnay Norway, waxaanan bilaabay in aan aado iskool si aan u barto Norwejiga. Waxay ahayd waqti adag. Maan haysan shatiga darawalnimada, ninkaygu waxa uu ku qasbanaaday in uu ii kaxeeyo iskoolka, isugo, dibna isoo celiyo. Waxay ahayd meel saacad noo jirta. Muddo ka dib waanu isku soo dhawaanay, laakiin wuxuu weli ku adkaystay inuu iskoolka ii wado. Ma uu rabin in aan keligay socdo.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Wax lacag ah ma helin tan iyo markii aan Norway imid. Mar ninkeygu wuxuu i siiyay lacag aan ku qadeeyo, laakiin maadaama aan haysto lacag aad u yar, waan xafiday. Saaxiibadayda iskoolka waxay rabaan inay i caawiyaan si aan shaqo u helo, laakiin ninkeyga wuxuu leeyahay ma awoodi karo. Uma maleynayo aan ka shaqada nadiifinta aysan igu habbooneen aniga.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Taa beddelkeeda shaqo kale ayuu ii qabtay -- oo ah dhisitaanka geerashka. Waxa uu ahaa masuulka anigana wax walbana waan sameenayey. Wax badan ma uu qaban karin sababtoo ah wuu xanuunsanaa. Lacagtii uu ku dhisay geerashka waxba igamuusan siin.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Maalin ayuu yiri waan ku caajisaa markuu guriga keligiis joogo, markaas ayuu go'aansaday inaan ey keensano. Ma rabin eey maadaama aan daalanahay iskoolkaa ka dib, waxaanan lahaa casharo la iga rabo inaan kaga shaqeeyo guriga. Waxa uu sheegay in uu socodsiin doono eeyga maalin kasta, laakiin ugu dambeyntii waa in aan daryeelo labadaba eeyga iyo ninkeyga odayga ah.

title: 0030_nin-oday-ah-marku-ninkaaga-yahay.md
text: Ma garanayo waxa mustaqbalka noqon doono. Qorshahaygu waa inaan iskool kale aado, laakiin ninkaygu ma rabo inaan taas sameeyo. Waxa uu qorshaynayaa inuu iga sii fogaayo si uu iigu adkeeyo. Waxaan rabaa inaan iska celiyo, laakiin ma garanayo sida. Ma fududa in dal shisheeye kula noolaado nin oday ah sidii ninkayga oo kale sida aan moodayay inay noqon doonto.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Atabo iyo Akiru waxeey
aadeen wabiga si ay
biyo uga soo
dhaansadaan.

text:
Marki ay guriga usoo

text:
Atabo waxuu isku dayay
inuu dhagaxii ka kaco
oo gurigii aado lakin
dhagaxii weeynaa ayaa
ku dhagay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Akiru waxuu ucararay

ugu soo sheego.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Markii ay hooyadii
timaaday meeshii
dhagaxa, waxa ay
aragtay Atabo oo
dhagaxii saaid ugu
dhagay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Hooyadii waxey tiri
Atabo, “waxaan kuu
sameenayaa deer oo ku
hareersan dhagaxa, si
uu kaaga difaaco
xayawaanada duur
joogta ah.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Kadib waxeey
sameesay deerkii, oo ay
usameesay hal albaab
oo ay kasoo gali jirtay.

Kadib hooyadii waxeey ku tiri Atabo,
“Markaan kuu imaado in aan cunto kuu
keeno, waan kuu heesi si aad iridka iga
furto”.
Heestaan aye uqaaday:
“lka koku nachirima,
Bala ekena,
Ke...ke...i...ya.
Tangarae totokonia kainak ngakon kile.”

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Hooyadii waxa kale oo ay ku tiri Atabo,
“Waligaa cid kale haka furin albaabka.”
Marwalbo oo ay hoyadii timaado waxeey
uqaadi jirtay heestan oo waa uu ka furi jiray
albaabka, kadibna Atabo aye cuntada siin
jirtay.

Lakin waraabe ayaa
udhuuman jiray oo
dhageesan jiray
markeey Atabo hooyadii
timaado.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Waraabihii waxuu isku
taxluujiyay inuu barto
heesta.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Xayawaanihii kale ayaa
waxeey ku dhaheen
waraabihii waxaad
wabiga kasoo laqdaa
taqsi si aad uheesto
heestan si fican.
Waraabihii wuxuu soo laqay taqsi waxuuna
isku dayay inuu heeso heestii, lakin

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Waraabihii markale
ayuu banaanka taqsi
kasoo laqay oo uu isku
dayay hadana in uu
heeso heestii, lakin
albaabkii ma furmin
hadana. - Ugu
dambeestii waraabihii
banaanka fog ayuu
taqsi kasoo laqay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Waraabihii waxuu soo
aaday in uu heeso
heestii, ugu dambeestii
na albaabkii wuu
furmay. Waraabihiina
Atabo ayuu cunay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Markii ay hooyadii
timaaday meeshii Atabo

uheestay, uheestay oo

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Hooyadii dab weyn
ayee shiday oo waxeey
iskugu yeertay

Waxeey tiri,
xayawaankii cunay
Atabo dabkaan ayuu ku
dhacayaa oo uu ku
gubanayaa.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Xayawaanadii oo dhan

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Dawacadii waa eey ka
booday dabkii lakin
seenta ayee ka
gubatay. Dabacadii
xanuun ayee la ooysay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Uga dambeestii
waraabihi ayaa lasoo
gaaray. Waa uu booday
lakin dabki ayuu ku
dhax dhacay.

title: 0034_waraabihii-dhooniga-ahaa.md
text:
Kadibna xayawaanadii
oo dhan hees kale ayee
uheeyseen:
“Ata kalio,
Anikanyamit ikon koku,
Achakakin nakim na,
Chi...gi...gir.”

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Markay Simbegwire hooyadeed dhimatay waxay ahayd mid aad u murugaysan. Simbegwire aabaheed waxuu sameeyay sida ugu fiican oo daryeelka gabadhiisa. Si tartiib ah waxay barteen in ay darreemaan farxad markale, la aanta simbegwire hooyadeed. Subax kasta waa ay fadhiistan kana wada hadli jireen wax ku saabsan malinta ka horayso. Fiid kasto waxay wada samayn jirreen cashada. Kadib waa ay dhaqaan maacuunta, aabaha Simbegwire waxuu ka caawin jiray shaqada guriga.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Halmaalin aabihii Simbegwire waxuu yimid guriga si kadib dhacsan sidii caadada u ahayd. "Xagee baad joogtaa ilmahayga" wuu u wacay. Simbegwire waxa ay ku oraday aabaheed. Waa ay istagtay si dhaqaaq la'aan ah markay aragtay in uu haysto gacanta haweeney. "Waxaan rabaa in aad lakulanto qof khaas ah, ilmahaygow. Tani waa Aniita," ayuu yidhi asagoo dhoolacadaynayo.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: "Halloo Simbegwire, aabahaa aya ii sheegay waxyaabo badan oo kugu saabsan." Ayay tidhii Anita. Laakiin ma aynan dhoolacadaynin mana ay qaadin gacanta gabadha. Simbegwire aabaheed waxuu ahaa mid aad u faraxsan oo xiiseynaya. Waxuu ka hadlay sida sedexdooda ay u wada noolaan doonan, iyo sida wanaagsanaan ay noloshooda ahaan doonto. "Ilmahayga, waxaan rajaynayaa in aad aqbali doonto Anita sidii hooyadaa o kale," ayuu yidhi.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Nolosha Simbegwire way isbadashay. Dambe uma aysan hellin waqti si ay arroorti ula fadhiisato aabaheed. Anita ayaa siisay shaqooyin badan oo guriga kamid ah, taas oo ka dhigtay mid aad uga daallisa ka shaqaynta shaqada iskuulka xilliga fidkii. Waxay si toos ah u aaday sarriirta cashada kadib. Raaxada kali ah ay haysatay waxuu aha bustihii midabaysnaa ooy hooyadeed siissay. Simbegwire aabaheed uma uusan muuqan mid ogaaday in gabadhiisa aysan faraxsanayn.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Dhowr bilood ka dib, Simbegwire aabaheed ayaa u sheegay ayaga in uu ahaan doono mid ka maqan guriga cabaar. "Waa inaan u safraa shaqadeyda," ayuu yiri. "Laakiin waan ogahay in aad is illaalin doontaan." Wajiga Simbegwire ayaa qushuucay, laakiin aabaheed ma ogaanin. Anita ma sheegin waxbo. Mana aysan faraxsaneyn.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Arrimaha way ku sii xumaadeen Simbegwire. Hadaysan dhamaynin shaqada ama aay cabato, Anita ayaa kudhufan. Xilliga cashada, haweenayda aya cuntay inta badan cuntada, ayadoo ureebayso Simbegwire waxyaabaha haraaga ah. Habbeen kasto Simbegwire ooyinta ayay ku seexan jirtay, ayaddoo bustihii hooyadeed hab siineyso.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Hal subax, Simbegwire ayaa ku daahday kasoo kiicida sariirta. "Gabadhaadan caajislayda ah!" Anita ku dhawaaqday. Waxaay simbegwire kasoo jiiday sariirtii. Bustihii qaaliga ahaa waxaa qabsaday musbaar, labo ayuu na u kala jeexay.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Simbegwire aad bay u xanaaqday. Waxay go'aansatay inay ka cararto guriga. Waxay qaadatay gogi'ii bustaha hooyadeed, waxay xiratay xogaa cunto ah, waxayna ka tagtay guriga. Waxay raacday wadadii aabaheed maray.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Markii ay fiidkii tahay, waxay kortay geed dheer oo u dhow dooxada waxayna nafteeda sariir uga samaysay laamaha. Sidaasey u seexatay, way heestay: "Hooyo, Hooyo, Hooyo, waad iga tagtay, waad iga tagtay oo mana aadan soo laaban, Aabbo ima jeclo. Hooyo,goormad dib u soo noqon, waad iga tagtay."

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Subbaxdii xigtay, Simbegwire waxay heetsay heesti markale. Markay dumarku yimaadeen dooxada si ay ugu dhaqdaan dharkooda, waxay maqleen hees murugo ah oo ka imaanayso geedka dheer. Waxay u maleeyeen in ay ahayd dabeysha oo kaliya oo lulaayso caleemaha, waxayna sii wateen shaqadoodi. Laakiin mid ka mid ah haweenka ayaa si taxaddar leh u dhegaystay heesta.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Naagtan waxay kor u eegtey geedkii gudihiisa. Markay aragtay gabadha iyo gogi'i bustaha midabka leh, waxay ku ooyday "Simbegwire, ilmihii walaalkay!" Dumarkii kale waxay joojiyeen dhaqistii waxayna caawiyeen Simbegwire si ay uga soo dagato geedka. Eedadeed ayaa hab siisay gabadhii yarayd, waxayna isku dayday inay dajiso.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Simbegwire eedadeed ayaa u qaaday ilmihi gurigeeda. Waxay siisay simbegwire cunto diiran, waxa ayna ku jiifisay sariir ayadoo haysata bustihii hooyadeeda. Habeenkaas, Simbegwire waa ay ooyday sideey ugu seexatay sariirta. Laakiin waxa ay ahayd ilin farxadeed. Waxay ogaatay in eedadeed illaalin doonto ayada.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Markii Simbegwire aabaheed ku soo laabtay guriga, wuxuu arkay qolkeedii oo madhan. "Maxaa dhacay, Anita?" wuxuu u waydiiyay si adag. Haweenaydi waxay u sharaxday in Simbegwire ay carrartay. "Waxaan rabay in ay i ixtiraamto," ayay tidhi. "Laakiin malaha waxaan ahaa mid aad ugu ad adag." Simbegwire aabaheed ayaa ka tagay guriga waxuuna aaday jahadii dooxada. Wuxuu socday illaa iyo tuuladii walaashii bal si uu u ogaado haddii ay aragtay Simbegwire

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Simbegwire waxay la ciyaaraysay ilma eedadeed markii ay ka aragtay aabaheed meel fog. Waxay ka cabsatay inuu xanaaqsanyahay, sidaa darteed waxay ku oraday guriga dhexdiisa si ay isku qariso. Laakiin aabbeheed baa u yimid waxuuna ku yidhi, "Simbegwire, waxaad u heshay naftaada hooyo kaamil ah. Taasoo ku jecel kuna fahmayso. Waan kugu faanaa waana ku jeclahay." Waxay ku heshiiyeen in Simbegwire ay la joogi doonto eedadeed inta ay rabto.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Aabaheed ayaa maalin walba soo booqan jiray. Ugu dambeyntii, wuxuu la yimid Anita. Waxay laacday Simbegwire gacanteedi. "Aad ayaan uga xumahay yariisey, waan qaldamay," ayay ku ooyday. "Ma ii ogolaaneysaa in aan mar kale isku daydo?" Simbegwire waxay eegtay aabaheed iyo wajigiisa welwelsan. Kadibna si tartiib ah ayay horay u socotay waxayna gacmaheeda ku wareejisay Anita.

title: 0052_simbegwire.md
text: Toddobaadkii kuxigay, Anita ayaa ku martiqaaday Simbegwire, ilmo eedadeed iyo eedadeed ba guriga iyo cunto. Maxay cunto ahayd! Anita waxay diyaarisay dhamaan cuntooyinki ay ugu jeclayd Simbegwire, qof kastana wuu cunay ilaa ay ka dhargaan. Kadibna carruurtu waa ay ciyaarayeen halka dadka waawayna sheekaysteen. Simbegwire waxay dareentay farxad iyo geesinimo. Waxay go'aansatay in si dhakhso, oo dhakhso ah, ay ku noqon doonto guriga si ay ula noolaato aabaheed iyo eedadeed/aayadeed.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Wakhti dheer ka hor, saddex gabdhood ayaa u baxay inay soo guurtan qoryo.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Waxay ahayd maalin kulul sidaa darteed waxay aaden webiga si ay ugu soo dabaashaan. Way cayaaren waxayna firdhiyeen kuna dabaasheen biyaha.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Si kadis ah, waxay xaqiiqsadeen in ay yihiin kuwa daahay. Waxay dib ugu soo dagdageen tuulada.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Markii ay ku dhawaadeen guriga, Nozibele waxay saartay gaceenteeda qoorta. Waxay soo iloowday silsiladeedii! "Fadlan ila laabta!" ayay kabariday saaxiibaddeeeda. Laakiin saaxiibaddeeda waxa ay dhaheen waa xilli aad u dambe.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Sidaas darteed Nozibele ayaa kaligeed dib ku laabatay webiga. Way heshay silsiladeedi waxayna usoo dhaqsatay guriga. Laakiin waxay ku luntay mugdiga.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Meel fog waxay ka aragtay iftiin ka imaanayo aqal. Waxay u dhakhsatay dhinaciisa waxayna garaacday albaabka.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: La yaabkeda, ey aya ka furay albaabka oo ku yidhi, "Maxaad doonaysaa?" "Waan lumay waxaana u baahanahay meel aan seexdo," ayay Nozibele tidhi. "Soogal, ama waan ku qaniini doonaa!" ayuu yidhi eygi. Sidaas darteed Nozibele way gashay gudaha.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Kadib eeygii wuxuu ku yidhi, "Cunto ii kari!" "Laakiin waligay marna wax uma karrinin eey," ayay ku jawaabtay. "Kari, ama waan ku qaniini doonaa!" ayuu egya yidhi. Sidaas darteed Nozibele waxeey xoogaa cunto ah u karisay eeygii.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Kadib eeygii wuxuu yidhi, "Sariirta ii hagaaji!" Nozibele ayaa ku jawaabtay, "Waligay marna sariir uma hagaajinin eey." "Sariirta hagaaji, ama waan ku qaniini doonaa!" ayuu eygi yidhi. Sidaas darteed Nozibele way hagaajisay sariirti.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Maalin kasta waxay ku qasbanayd in ay wax kariso, nadiifiso oo u dhaqdo eeyga. Dabadeedna, maalin aya eeygii yidhi, "Nozibele, maanta waa in aan booqdaa saaxiibo, nadiifi guriga, cuntada kari, oo dhaq alaabta kahor intaanan soo laaban."

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Dhakhsaba sidaas tuu eeyga u tagay, Nozibele ayaa madaxa ka soosiibtay saddex timood. Waxay hal tin dhigtay sariirta hoosteeda, mid kalane albaabka gadaashiisa, midna gudaha xerada. Kadibna waxay u carartay guriga sida ugu dhakhsaha badan oo ay awooday.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Markii eygii dib u soo laabtay, wuxuu raadiyay Nozibele. "Nozibele, xagee baad joogtaa?" ayuu ku qayliyey. "Waa ikan, sariirta hoosteeda," ayay tiri tintii ugu horraysay. "Waa ikan, albaabka ka gadaashiisa," ayay tiri tintii labaad. "Waa ikan, gudaha xerada," ayay tiri tintii saddexaad.

title: 0066_nozibele-iyo-saddexdii-timo.md
text: Dabadeed eeygii waxuu ogaaday in Nozibele ay sirtay. Sidaas darteed eeygii wuu orday oo ku orday wadadi illaa iyo tuulada. Laakiin walaalaha Nozibele ayaa halkaas ku sugayay iyagoo ulo waaweyn. Eeygii wuu jeestay oo wuu cararay, waligiisna dib looma arag.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Tani waa sheekada Ngede, shimbir-malabka, iyo nin yar oo dhuuni ah laguna magacaabay Gingile. Maalin goor uu Gingile ugaarsi tagay maqlay ci'da Ngede. Gingile afkiisa ayaa bilaabay in uu dhareero niyeysiga malab dartii. Wuu istaagay wuu na dhagaystay si taxadar ah, oo uu raadiyay ilaa uu arkay shimbirkii oo laamaha korka madaxiisa ku jiro. "Jiiq-jiiq-jiiq," ayuu ku shanqaray shimbiarki yaraa, isaga oo u duulay geedka ku xigo, hadana kan kale. "jiiq-jiiq-jiiq," ayuu ku ciyay, istaagayana marba mar si uu u hubsado in uu Gingile soo raacay.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Saacad barkeed ka dib, waxa ay soo gaareen geed berde duur baaxad le. Ngede waxa uu si waalli ah ugu boodbooday laamihii geedka. Dabadeedna waxa uu dul dagay mid ka mid ah laamihii, waxa uu na madaxiisa ku soo leexiyay Gingile sidii in la dhahayo, "Waa kan! Kaalay hada! Maxaa waqtigaas dheeer u qaadaneysaa?" Gingile kama uusan arki karayn wax shinni ah geedka hoostiisa, laakiin waxa uu aaminay Ngede.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Gingile waxa uu warrankii ugaarsiga dhigtay geedka hoostiisa, waxa uu soo aruursaday xaabo, dab ayuuna shiday. Markii uu dabkii si fiican u shidmay, qori dheer oo qallalan ayuu dabkii galiyay. Qorigani waxuu khaasatan caan ku ahaa in uu sameeyo qiiq badan marka la shido. Waxa uu bilaabay fuullidii, isaga oo ilkaha ku haya dhanka qaboow ee qoriga qiiqaya.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Markiiba waxa uu maqli karay "sss-ssss" da dheer ee shinnida mashquulsan. Waxa ay ka galeysay kana soo baxaysay shinniddu meel dulleesha oo geedka jirriddiisa ah - hoygeeda. Markii uu Gingile gaaray hoygii shinnida waxa uu qorigi qiiqayay ku riixay meeshii duleeshay. Shinnidii banaanka ayay u yaacday, sababtoo ah ma jeclayn qiiqa - laakin intaa ka hor waxay Ginglie siiyeen xoogaa qaniinyo kulul!

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Markii ay shinnidii tagtay, Gingile waxa uu gacantiisa ku riixay buulki malabku ku jiray. Waxa uu kala soo baxay gacan buuxdo xabag-barsheed, tiftifqayso malab iyo diirdiir cadcad oo buudhan. Waxa uu si taxaddar leh ugu riday xabag-barsheedkii kiish uu garabka ku sitay, geedkiina waa uu ka soo degay.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Ngede waxa uu si xiiso leh u daawanayay wax walba oo uu Gingile sameynayey. Waxa uu sugayay in uu uga tago cad xabag-barsheed buurran ah Shimbir-malabka si mahad celin ah. Ngede laanba laan ayuu uga duulay, ugu na sii dhawaanayay dhulka. Ugu dambeyn Gingile geedka salkiisi ayuu gaadhay. Ngede dhagax u dhow wiilka ayuu dul istaagay waxuu na suggay abaalmarintiisii.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Laakiin, Gingile dabkii ayuu damiyey, warrankiisii na qaatay oo socodkii gurigiisa billaabay, isaga oo inkiraya shimbirki. Ngede si carro leh ayuu u ciyey, "Fiiq-fifiq-fiifiiq!" Gingile inta istaagay, oo shimbirki yaraa eegay ayuu aad ugu qoslay. "Waxa aad rabtaa xoogaa malab ah, ma rabtaa, saaxiib? Ha! Laakiin hawsha oo dhan aniga ayaa qabtay, aniga ayaana qaatay qaniiyo oo idil. Maxaan kuula qaybsadaa malabkan la jecelyahay?" Dabadeedna wuu iska dhaqaaqay. Ngede aad ayuu u carooday! Ma ay ahayn in sidan loola dhaqmo! Lakiin wuu aargoosan doonaa!

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Asbuucyo badan kadib, maalin, markale ayuu Gingile maqlay ci'da malab sheega ee Ngede. Waxa uu xusuustay malabkii macaanaa, si xiiso leh na u dabagalay shimbirkii mar kale. Sidii uu kaynta dhinaceeda ugu horkacayey Gingile, Ngede waxuu dul istaagay geed weyn oo qodxo dallad ah leh si uu ugu nasto. "Ahh," Gingile ayaa ku fikiray. "Godka shinnida geedkan un buu ku yaal." dhaqso ba waxuu samaystay dabkii si yaraa waxa uuna bilaabay in uu fuulo, laanti yarayd ee qiiqeysayna ilkaha ku sita. Ngede wuu fariistay oo iska daawaday.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Gingile wuu fuulay, la yaabbanaa sababta uu u maqli waayay "Sss-sss-sss" di caadiga ahayd. "Malaha godku gudaha geedka ayuu sii jiraa," ayuu ku fikiray. Laan kale ayuu kor usii fuulay. Laakiin halkii godkii shinnida eegii lahaa, waxa uu indhaha ku dhuftay haramcad! Haramcaddu aad bay uga carootay in hurdadeedii si edeb darro ah looga dhexgalay. Indhaha ayay isku kuduudday, afkeedana way kala qaadday iyada oo ilkaheeda waaweyn ee afka badan dibedda u soo saaraysa.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Intii ay haramcaddu weerarin Gingile, si degdeg ayuu hoos uga degay geedki. Degdeggii awgii ayuu laan gafay, waxa uu si shanqar culus leh ugu dhacay dhulka oo wareejiyay canqowgiisi. Sidii ugu dhakhsaha badneyd ee uu karay ayuu u dhutiyay. Nasiib lahaayaa, haramcaddu aad bay weli u sii hurdeysnayd haday cayrsan lahayd. Ngede, Shimbir-malabkii, wuu helay aargoosigi. Gingile na cashar ayuu bartay.

title: 0072_aargoosigii-shimbir-malabka.md
text: Sidaa darteed, markii Gingile ay carruurtiisa maqlaan sheekada Ngede waxa ay ixtiraam u qaadaan shimbirka yar. Mar walba oo ay malab soo gurtaan, waxa ay xaqiijiyaan in ay qeybta ugu weyn xabad barsheeedka uga tagaan shimbir malabka!

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Waxaan jeclahay in aan aqriyo.

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Qofkeen u aqrin karaa?

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Walaasheey waa ay hurudaa.

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Qofkeen u aqrin karaa?

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Hooyadey iyo ayeeyadey waa ay mashquulsanyihiin.

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Qofkeen u aqrin karaa?

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Aabahey iyo awoowgay waa ay mashquulsanyihiin.

title: 0087_waxaan-jeclahay-in-aan-aqriyo.md
text: Qofkeen u aqrin karaa?Aniga ayaa is ku aqrin karaayo.

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Tani waa Kalaay. Waxay jirtaa toddoba sano. Magaceeda macnihiisa waa "midda wanaagsan" luqaddeeda, Lubukusu.

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Kalaay way soo toostaa waxeyna lahadashaa geedka liinta ah. "Fadlan geedka liinta ahoow, weynoow oo na sii liin badan oo bissil."

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Kalaay waxay aadaa dugsiga. Jidka waxay kula hadashaa cawska. "Fadlan caws, weynoow cagaaro oo ha qallalin."

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Kalaay waxay soo martaa ubaxyo duureed. "Fadlan ubaxyo, sii magoola, si aan timaheyga idiin saarto."

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Iskuulka, Kalaay waxay la hadashaa geedka dhexda xerada ku yaallo. "Fadlan geed, so saar laamo waaweyn si aan ugu akhrisano hooskaada."

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Kalaay waxay la hadashaa bowdka ku wareegsan dugsigeeda. "Fadlan u kora si awoodleh oo joojiya soogallida dadka xun."

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: Markay Kalaay guriga ku laabato, waxay booqataa geedka liinta." Miyay bislaadeen midhahaada wali?" Ayey weydisaa Khalaay.

title: 0089_kalaay-waxay-la-hadashaa-dhirta.md
text: "Liinta weli waa cagaar," ayay ku neef tuurtay Kalaay "Waxaan ku arki doonaa berrito geedka liintaw," ayay tidhi Khalaay. "Malaha markaas baad ii yeelan doonto midho liin ah oo bislaaday!"

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Walaalkeyga yar wuxuu seexdaa waqti dambe. Anigu waxaan soo toosaa xilli hore, maxaa yeelay waa mid aad u wanaagsan!

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Anigu waxaan ahay kan qorraxda soo bixiyo.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: "Waxaad tahay xiddigta subaxdayda," ayuu yidhi Mama.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Anigu waan maydhaa, ma u baahni wax caawin ah.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Waxaan u dul qaadan karaa biyo qabow iyo saabuun shiirayso oo buluug ah.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Mama aya i xasuusiyo, "Ha iloobin ilkaha." Waxaan ku jawaabaa, "Marnaba, aniga ma ihi!"

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Ka dib markii aan maydho, waxaan salaamaa awoowe iyo eedo, oo waxaan u rajeeyaa ayaga maalin wanaagsan.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Dabadeedna waan labistaa, "hadda waan weynahay Mama," ayaan dhahaa.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Waxaan xidhi karaaguluusyadeeyda iyo suunka kabahayga.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Waxaan na hubiyaa in walaalkeyga yar uu yaqaano dhamaan wararka iskuulka.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Fasalka dhexdiisa waxaan ku dadaalayaa sida ugu fiican.

title: 0095_zama-waa-mid-aad-u-wanaagsan.md
text: Waxyaabahan wanaagsan oo dhan waxaan sameeyaa maalin kasta. Laakiin waxa aan ugu jeclahay, waa in aan ciyaaro oo aan ciyaaro!

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Tuulo ku taal dhinaca hooseyo buurta Kenya ee Bariga Afrika, gabar yar ayaa hooyadeed kala shaqeyn jirtay beeraha. Magaceedu waxa uu ahaa Wangari.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari bannaanka ayay aad u jeclaan jirtay. Baangad ayay ku qodqodday carrada beerta qoyskooda. Waxayna dhulka qandacsan ku aastay miro aad u yaryar.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Watigay ugu jeclayd maalinta waxa uu ahaa marka ay cadceeddu dhacdo. Marka ay mugdi saaid u noqoto aragtida dhirta, Wangari waxay ogaataa in ay tahay xilligii ay guriga aadi lahayd. Waxayna qaadaa waddoyin dhuudhuuban oo dhex maro beeraha, ayadoo gudbeyso webi yaal markay baxdo.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari waxa ay ahayd ilma farriid ah wayna sugi la eyd in ay iskuul aado. Laakiin hooyadeed iyo aabbaheed waxa ay doonayeen in ay joogto oo ay guriga ka caawiso. Markii ay toddoba jirsatay, walaalkeed ka weyn ayaa ku qalqaaliyey waalidkeed in ay u oggolaadaan in ay iskuul aaddo.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Way jeclayd in ay wax barato! Wangari waxay wax ka baratay in badan oo badan buug walbey aqrisay. Iskuulka oo ay aad ugu wanaagsanaatey darteed waxaa lagu casuumay in ay wax ku barato dalka Maraykanka. Wangari waa ay faraxday! Waxa ay doonaysay in ay wax badan ka ogaato dunida.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari wax badan oo cusub ayay ku baratay jaamacada maraykanka. Waxa ay baratay dhirta iyo sida ay u baxaan. Waxa ayna xusuusatay sidii ay usoo kortay: la ciyaarki walaaladeed hooska geedaha kaymihii qurxoonaa ee Kenya.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Markii ay wax sii barataba, waxa ay sii ogaanaysay in ay dadka Kenya aad u jeceshahay. Waxa ay doonaysay in ay noqdaan kuwo faraxsan oo xor ah. Markii ay wax sii barataba, waxa ay soo xusuusan jirtay gurigeedii Afrika.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Markii ay wax barashadeedii dhammeysatay, waxa ay ku noqotay Kenya. Laakiin wadankeedii waa is beddelay. Beero baaxad leh ayaa is daba jiidnaa dalki. Haweenku ma heysan xaabo ay wax ku karsadaan. Dadku fakhri ayay ahaayeen, carruurtuna waa ay gaajeysnaayeen.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari way garanysay waxa ay tahay in la sameeyo. Waxa ay bartay haweenkii sida dhirta miro looga abuuro. Haweenku dhirta ayay sii iibin jireen lacagta ka soo baxdana waxay u isticmaali jiren in ay qoysaskooda ku daryeelaan. Haweenkii waxa ay noqdeen kuwo faraxsan. Wangari ayaa ka caawisay in ay dareemaan awooddooda iyo xoog.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Waxuu waqti gudbo ba, dhirtii cusbeyd waxa ay noqotay kayn, webiyadiina mar kale ayay biyo keeneen. Farriintii Wangari, Afrika ayay ku faaftay. Maanta, malaayiin geedo ah ayaa ka soo baxay mirihii Wangari.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari si adag ayay u shaqeysay. Dadka dunida oo dhan ayaa ogaaday, waxaa na la siiyey abaalmarin caan ah. Waxa la yiraahdaa Abaalmarinta Nabada ee Nobel, waxa ayna noqotay haweeneyda ugu horeysay ee kaligeed Afrika laga siiyey abid.

title: 0110_mir-yar-sheekadii-wangari-mathaay.md
text: Wangari waxa ay dhimatay 2011, laakiin waa aannu xusuusannaa mar walba oo aan aragno geed qurux badan.

title: 0111_waa-maxay-sababta-aysan-jeerta-ulahayn-timo.md
text: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Bakayle ayaa socday wabiga qarkiisa.
